description:
Hello, our home is located in the central area , you can discover Kadikoy by walking, couple of minutes away from Gazhane. You can easily reach metrobus, bus, metro, Marmaray and ferry stations. Passing to European side never been so easy !

We have heating system for full house, AC in living room and ceiling fan in bedroom.
There is always sunlight in the home which makes our home cozy and bright :) We do have full kitchen, you can enjoy cooking.

We are excited to welcome you:)

reviews.text: We are very grateful to the hostess for the accommodation, the accommodation is located in a quiet area, with an excellent transport interchange, the apartment is located near a beautiful embankment (one station on marmaray). The apartment was a little dusty, but it's not scary, we additionally wiped everything ourselves with disinfectant wipes, of which there were a lot at home, the apartment fully corresponds to the photos. The hostess was very responsive and attentive to our requests and questions, thank you very much.

Ev tam olarak fotoğraflarda gösterildiği gibi içiniz rahat olabilir. İstanbul’ da konaklamam gerektiğinde kesinlikle tekrar bu evde konaklamak isterim. Bulunduğu yerde birçok market ve restoran seçeneği mevcut. Otobüs durağı da eve çok yakın. Ayrıca yanınızda bir polis merkezi olması sizi oldukça rahatlatıyor. Eve girdiğimiz an gelen kokulardan yeni temizlenmiş olduğunu anladık. İçerisi çok düzenli ve temizdi bu konuda hiçbir sorun yaşamadık. Soğuk havaya rağmen evin içerisi sıcacıktı. Ütü, kurutma makinesi, bulaşık makinesi, çamaşır makinesi ve hatta bebek sandalyesi bile ihtiyacınıza göre konulmuştu. Özge hanım bir sorumuz olduğunda bizimle hemen iletişime geçti kendisine çok teşekkür ederiz. İstanbul’ a gidip konaklayacak herkese gözüm kapalı tavsiye ederim. Çok güzel bir seyahat oldu.

Konaklamamız boyunca her şey tek kelimeyle harikaydı. Özge Hanım son derece kibar, ilgili ve her konuda yardımcı bir ev sahibiydi. İletişimimiz en başından son ana kadar çok kolay ve rahattı.
Annem ve babamla birlikte konakladık ve kendimizi gerçekten kendi evimizde gibi hissettik. Bir otelin sunamayacağı rahatlığı ve sıcaklığı yaşadık. Ev tertemizdi, hijyen konusunda içimiz çok rahattı. İhtiyacımız olan her şey eksiksiz düşünülmüştü.
Konumu da mükemmeldi. Metrobüs ve Marmaray’a sadece 2-3 dakikalık yürüme mesafesinde, Kadıköy Boğa’ya ise yaklaşık 10-15 dakikada yürüyerek ulaşabiliyorsunuz. Buna rağmen bulunduğu bölge oldukça sakin ve güvenliydi. Karakolun hemen yanında olması da ayrıca güven verdi.
İstanbul’a tekrar geldiğimizde hiç düşünmeden yine burada kalmayı tercih ederiz. Her şey için Özge Hanım’a çok teşekkür ederiz. Gönül rahatlığıyla herkese tavsiye ediyoruz.

Everything about the apartment was nice. Building was in a good location with easy access. Apartment (especially bathroom and kitchen utensils like teapot. pan e.t.c.) could be cleaner. But there was not a big issue as when we informed Ozge about the problem she sent cleaning lady in a very short time. Ozge was very responsive, friendly and helpful. I enjoyed of staying there.
Özge’s place was so clean, comfortable and exactly as described. She was incredibly helpful and responsive. Had an amazing stay!

description:
Conveniently set in Istanbul, Homelike Hotel provides air-conditioned rooms, a restaurant and free WiFi. The property is located 2 km from Istiklal Street. The accommodation features a 24-hour front desk.

All units at the hotel are equipped with a TV with satellite channels and a safety deposit box. The private bathroom is equipped with a shower, free toiletries and a hairdryer. At Hotel each room include towels

Popular points of interest near the accommodation include Istanbul Taksim Square.

reviews.text: fotoğraflardaki gibi bir oda oldukça temiz konumu merkezi kahvaltısı yeterli çok memnum kaldık eşimle birlikte hafta sonu gezisi için geldik çalışanlarda oldukça kibar ve yardımseverdi
Konum ve fotoğraflar doğruydu. Her şey kusursuzdu sakin ve güzel bir yerdi. Gökhan bey çok yardımcı oldu. Rahatlıkla tercih edebilirsiniz
Gokhan's place is very central and clean and he is extremly helpfull host and kind towards guests. i recommend to everyone

I had such a wonderful stay! Everything exceeded my expectations — we were even kindly upgraded to another room, which was a lovely surprise. The hosts are incredibly nice, welcoming, and present when you need anything. You can really feel they care. The space was clean, cozy, and just perfect for our time there. I’d definitely come back again — highly recommended!
Special thanks to Maya, she’s the sweetest person. Keep up the good work (and the smile).
Thank you all :).

Öncelikle konum olarak ideal bir lokasyonda.
Çevresinde yemek ve eğlence için birden fazla mekan mevcut.
Oda gayet temiz, ferah ve konforlu.
Resepsiyon hizmetleri etkin ve personel özverili.
Harbiye'ye ve beşiktaş'a yürüme mesafesinde.
Kahvaltısı açık büfe ve yiyecekler lezzetli.
Kesinlikle konaklamanızı tavsiye ederim.
Çok memnun kaldık.
Tekrar konaklamak isteriz.

description: PETRA is a stylish one bedroom and lounge room flat located in BEYOGLU only a few steps away from Istiklal Street. PETRA is close to all major tourist attractions.

reviews.text:
Ogul was a fantastic host, so courteous and polite, even when I overslept past my check out time (sorry Ogul!). The apartment is just as it seems in the pictures, maybe even better, elegant and tastefully tastefully decorated


UPS:
the bed in the bedroom is possibly the most comfortable bed I've ever slept on, I just didn't want to get out of bed in the morning.

- The Sunday bazaar outside of the house is just awesome, it fills the street with stalls selling everything from groceries to household good.

- The location is very central (not far to hard rock cafe and to galtasaray school) , while not the prettiest place I've ever seen, it felt pretty safe, though I talked to some turks who said it was safe, so I'm not sure what to believe. I felt safe though.

COULD BE BETTER:

- Kitchen knives were not sharp
- There were a few cooking pans but not really enough to make a big meal.

DOWNS:

- The walls are paper thin and you can hear every word and movement from the flat above, bring ear plugs if you want to sleep!

- The shower temperature fluctuates from warm to cold quite a bit, there are two shower heads (1 x rain shower head and 1 x regular head) only the regular head work the rain shower head does not.

Above all I think the property offered goo value for money

Overall nice stay for one week in Istanbul for NYE. Apartment is clean and confortable. 5 minutes walk from Istiklal and its shops, 15 min from Taksim square and also Galata quarter. Nice market on sundays (all day long) in front of the place.

More details here :
@ ++ things :
- Quick/Efficient/Affordable airport Pick-up/Drop-off
- Kitchen is fine for heating up take away food or fast cooking (Drinkable water jug available at the flat is OK)
- Bed and linen of very good quality. Fine after walking a lot during the day

@ average things :
- Surroundings of the flat are not so reassuring at first (beggers, trashs & dirts around, few lights only) but we ended up feeling OK as people are very respectfull and only leaving there
-Insulation of the flat is very poor for winter times (door+windows especially). Heating of the place was OK so we were not cold but its not so great in December...

-- things :
-Ceilings and walls are super-thin (all building belongs to the same Host) so be prepared to hear your neighbours do pretty much everything (!) from walking at night to discussing or showering... If you meet with other nice travelers in the building its easy to be carefull, if not good luck with it!
- Wi-fi not working so well with two cellphones connected
- We switched on TV only once to check International news but couldn't find any international channels ... better get rid of theTV in such case.
-Missing some audio display (small Hi-FI, Mp3 dock, etc.)

Overall stay is OK comparing to overpriced hotel rooms in Istanbul , but I'd rather come back in summer!

The apartment is located on a sketchy-looking street but thankfully we never had any issues. It very close to the main pedestrian street with shops and restaurants, and Taksim square is just a 10 minute walk away. The kitchen is well equipped and the apartment was nice and clean, as on pictures.
Sometimes it was noisy due to traffic and thin walls, as well as the Sunday market. We encountered problems with hot water but managed to fix it ourselves. The insulation of windows and doors it not too good, there was a permanent draft and was quite cold despite having the heating on (we stayed there in March).
However the check-in management part we are hardly satisfied - one of us booked an earlier flight just to arrive in time for check-in and then arrived to meet the host at precisely 7pm (heavy traffic in the city), but by the time the paperwork was done it was 7:07 and we had to pay 20 EUR extra because of this - a little flexibility would not hurt and would have left us satisfied.

The listing description was not just accurate but better than expected. The apartment was very clean, the facilities worked perfectly and in general we had no real issues. One minor issue is that the wifi strength is poor. I am not sure though how much better it can get in this area. The host was very welcome and available for help during our whole stay. When we arrived, we were a bit sceptic about the neighborhood. It is rather deprived area and lots of noise during the night hours, cause of traffic. However, looking at the positive side, we were able to also experience this part of Istanbul.

We really enjoyed our stay at Petra, Ogul the host was easy to get hold of and very helpful even late at night and early in the morning. When the shower drain blocked there was someone there to fix it within five minutes. The apartment is clean and well appointed, the bed is comfortable and the space is light and comfortable.

We asked for an iron as we were attending a wedding and there was a board and iron available but the ironing board would benefit from a cover. The television didn't work but this wasn't high on our list of priorities. This is easily made up for by the apartment's location.

The location is fantastic, a short walk to Taksim Square through the bustling and lively streets of Taksim, amazing shops and bars and restaurants everywhere. We went out for a short walk in the early evening and didn't come home until the early hours!

We loved the fact that it felt like we were part of the neighbourhood. A fantastic street market on the Sunday with amazing fruit and vegetables, friendly shop owners, and life all around.

In short, it felt like a little home away from home. Perfect for us, we hope to come back.

description:
It is at a vibrant neighborhood nestled in the heart of Istanbul. Here are some fantastic attractions and must-visit spots within walking distance or a short commute from your Airbnb:

1. Hagia Sophia (Ayasofya)

2. Sultanahmet Square:(Blue Mosque, Basilica Cistern)

3. Topkapi Palace

4. Grand Bazaar (Kapalı Çarşı)

5. Spice Bazaar (Mısır Çarşısı)
Seaside is also at walking distance, it is a good spot to RUN or walking.

reviews.text: A great place to stay in the Sultanahmet district! Walking distance from all the most important sites of the city, as well as to the tram station. Many great restaurants around. The district also felt really safe. Gohar is a quickly-responding host, and she was very flexible in regard of our arrival, which was after midnight. The apartment is spacious, with a clean bathroom, working AC and amenities such as a hair dryer, a kettle and cutlery. It is worth noticing that the apartment is on the third floor, with some very steep stairs. The only cons were: some smell in the bathroom (seems to be an Istanbul’s essential), lavatory seat only put on the lavatory and from time to time the water would drop down from the AC (and the AC is vital in the summer). All in all: a place worth recommendation!

The apartment was easy to find and the host gave clear instructions how to check in.
The apartment looked dirtier then at the photos (photos gave wrong impression because they are blurry and small details are not visible). The shower was dirty. It needs a deep cleaning and detailing.
The bed was broken in one of the corners, it didn’t give much inconvenience though, we were able to sleep.
The towels were smelling bad and sheets were dirty and had hair.

5/5 stars! The location in Fatih is absolutely perfect for exploring the historic sites. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was very helpful and check-in was seamless. Highly recommended!

Such a pleasant stay we had for one week in Istanbul! Gohar is such a lovely host! I can’t thank her enough for letting us to do an early check in as we arrived in Istanbul early in the morning and lack of sleep from overnight flight. She is super responsive and lives on the second floor in case you need anything, just reach out to her and she’ll take care of it.
The room is exactly as it is in the pictures, we used TV, washing machine, and AC it was all working well. AC works great especially to recover from summer heat. The curtain makes us sleep better and the surrounding area is quiet at night although it’s around the tourist areas. However, keep in mind that the room located on the third floor with a quite steep stairs, thus it might not that convenient if you have large luggage. We traveled with only backpacks so it was easier to come upstairs.

We truly enjoyed our stay at Gohar’s apartment. It was clean and comfortable. The location was ideal, with easy access to shops, restaurants, and public transport. Gohar was friendly and helpful throughout our stay.
The only inconvenience was the stairs, which could be tiring after a long day, particularly when carrying luggage.

description: This flat is in a very central point of Istanbul. It is adjacent to Istanbul Medical University (ÇAPA) and Bezmi Alem University. Beyazıt Square is 15 minutes, Aksaray is 10 minutes, Laleli is 12 minutes away, Sultanahmet Square and Mosque is 20 minutes away, Hagia Sophia is 20 minutes away, Grand Bazaar is 20 minutes away, Eminönü is 25 minutes away from our flat. There are many restaurants, markets and cafes within a few minutes walking distance. Public transport stops are just 5 minutes.

reviews.text:
I had a great stay at this Airbnb! The place was exactly as shown in the photos — clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. The host was very polite, communication was easy, and he was always responsive.
The only downsides were the location, which is a bit far from most of the main places you’d want to visit in Istanbul, and the stairs leading to the apartment. The stairs are quite steep, which can make it difficult for anyone with a baby ( which was my case ) ,luggage, or mobility concerns.
Overall, it was still a pleasant stay, and I appreciate the host’s hospitality.

Bahar and her husband are very responsive and replied to all my requests and questions within minutes. I even locked myself out of the house and they came within 5 minutes to help me. The check in was easy and directions are very clear. The home is very clean and looks exactly like the photos. We stayed for over 3 weeks and it really felt like home. I cook most nights and the home has everything you need to prepare dinners. Transportation is easy with the metro just a few minutes walk. Capa is a very lively but very safe neighborhood with lots of wonderful restaurants and tea shops right across the Main Street. It was a quiet neighborhood and we were able to usually find close parking. Loved it so much we will definitely stay again when we return to Istanbul.

The place is exactly as described and loaded with everything that you could possibly think of and went above and beyond to make sure you feel at home, spotless clean, perfect location close to the center of Istanbul were you could get transportation to anywhere around the city, a lot of great restaurants around here that you really get overwhelmed with options and open till late, Hosts got us cover in everything we needed and very responsive and respectful, Thanks to both Şaban and Bahar for the great hospitality and swiftly fixing the kitchen faucet in time, we liked the place and the Hosts so much that we asked to extend our stay.

Bahar and Saban were very helpful with a quick response to our messages since we booked. Check in was very easy. The house was very clean and match the photos. Everything we needed was also available.
The location of the apartment is excellent, everything is nearby public transport (the tram-station and the bus station ) supermarkets and restaurants.
The surroundings were quiet and safe.
We enjoyed our stay and we will come again in our next visit to Istanbul

Really nice apartment, very clean and ordered. Kitchen stuff for cooking, very comfortable bed. Perfect location with public transport and next to a main avenue with lots of life. Communication with the hosts easy and fast. Thanks for everything!

description:
Welcome
Cosy&Safe&Clean Flat Downtown Pera



ALL SERVICES INCLUDED PRICE.



Turkish Local sim card and mobile phone.

Istanbul Card for public transportation .

Guide Book Map etc

reviews.text:
Whom ever is reading this post let me say, this was a great stay and Can the host was extremely accommodating!! On entry to the city he had already organized VIP transport to his apartment and back to the airport at the end (free of charge).

His place was "very" clean and neat, he made a point in discussion on our last day that he has learnt through his own airbnb experiences and good constructive criticism on what was important and cleanliness was up there on his list. The decor was modern and artistic with a splash of vintage collectables I.e. Dated Singer sewing machine and analogue radio as ornaments. Some of his furniture has been cleverly constructed from antiques (table /benchtop from the old singer stand) - all clean and functional.

All the necessities were available: microwave, aircon, Internet, hot water and kitchen appliances I.e. Kettle (you don't know how much this is needed until you don't have one). He also provided an assortment of complimentary teas and coffees. All bed sheets, towels, robes, shower slippers, soaps/shampoos etc were provided in hotel like provisions. Not to mention a Lonely Planet book and Map for use. The apartment was 2minutes walk from the main and lively street Istiklal Caddessi, 5-10min walk from Galata Tower and Galata Bridge (seaside), we even casually walked one day to Tepkapi Place, Grand Bazaar, Sophia Hagia which took 45mins or so (depending on how often you stop since Istanbul by nature has some hill'y streets) - hence VERY close to everything.
"Can" was always a phone call away (especially when you struggle to find people who scan speak English - which He does proficiently) and was insistent if we were missing anything he'd provide it. 'Can' was a charming young man, very polite and also had a sense of humour. Thanks Can it was great to have met and the stay was memorable. (Quote "Hasta La Vista." - Can)

Our host Can is the sweetest man in the world! He is charming, helpful and has a marvellous sense of humor. We stayed at the apartment for almost 20 days and we feel it like home. Everything is like on the photos - it's clean and stylish. You will have everything that you need inside. The location is perfect - very close walking from Istiklial Street, Galata and Taksim. There are many restaurant just 5 min. walking distance and 24/7 market next door. We are very happy that we choose Can's apartment!

Can has been an excellent host from the day I made the reservation till after I left his beautiful apartment. Always on call when I asked him anything and checking on me if I needed something throughout my stay. The apartment is very stylish yet cozy. The bedroom is very quiet and the bed and pillows very comfortable. Living room is very spacious with a big couch to relax on and a nice table to have your meals. The apartment really has all the amenities someone would need and more. What I appreciated especially was the quality of the linen and the towels and how everything was fresh and clean. These little details make you feel like home :) Finally the location is very convenient, less than 5 minutes walking to the middle of Istiklal street from where you can reach every point of interest in Istanbul. All in all an excellent and highly recommended choice!

This is an exceptional unit with a great location in Istanbul. The apartment is very comfortable, with a large bedroom, large living room and nice kitchen and bathroom. The host provides a large assortment of coffee and tea, as well as nice extra amenities like bath robes, slippers, a guide book, etc. There's also a nice little store below the unit for buying beverages, etc.

It was extremely easy communicating with the hosts and getting keys, asking questions, etc.

When I come back to Istanbul I will most surely book this flat, and I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a quieter part of Beyoğlu next to all of the action.

Hi everybody!! Istanbul is unforgettable city!! This flat is amazing and very stylish. There is everything you need for perfect staying. It's very good located, clean, bright, comfortable... Next time I'll stay exactly here.!

description:
Peace in the middle of the city!,
It has all the basic amenities

reviews.text: Great spot with one of the most fantastic views I have ever experienced. Super responsive host. The area is in a bit of an interesting neighborhood, almost felt a bit abandoned, but only a few minutes walk to the main streets and shops. Restaurants and bodegas only a minute walk away. The general area, like much of Turkey, is older. There was a small issue with water one day, but it was a neighborhood issue and not an apartment issue. They communicated well and made up for it with their kindness and flexibility. Great hosts, great view. Oh, there’s not elevator, but you can stay fit using the stairs 😅 We loved our stay, especially our little guy! Thanks again. Would recommend.

The apartment is really nice and exactly as displayed in the pictures. The view is fantastic and you have everything you need. We did incur some issues with hot water and heating. While our hosts were always responsive, friendly and helpful - the issues could all be fixed - we did spent some (holiday-)time on communication and maintenance.
Another point is, that the apartment is very close to modern and more touristic streets. But its area itself is rather rough, although we never felt unsafe.

Excellent apartment for a very reasonable price. The price is worth the view alone, it's a phenomenal skyline view over Istanbul. The flat was absolutely fine for our needs - very large for two people in fact - but it was lacking in a few kitchen items (only 1 mug, no knives, no means of cooking/heating food). To be fair on the host this was warned about in the listing since they are still in the process of buying things for the flat, so I'm sure this won't be an issue for future guests. Host was communicative and the check-in instructions were very clear and straightfoward. The neighbourhood is a short walk away from the touristy Taksim Sq and Galata Tower areas.
I'd definitely recommend this place, especially if having an amazing view is a top priority for you in a city break.

We really enjoyed our stay at Ceren’s place! The apartment is in a good central location, a short distance to lots of cool cafes, bars and restaurants.
The apartment had everything we needed, and the view from the terrace was amazing - really makes the place stand out. The only minor thing was that elements of the apartment were slightly run down , though it didn’t affect our stay in any way.
The hosts are super responsive and helpful which was a big plus. We had an issue with hot water not switching on on our first day and despite messaging late in the evening we got an immediate reply with helpful instructions that resolved the issue. They also reached out to us to give us some transport advice as we were checking in on a national holiday.
Overall a very good experience!

I thoroughly enjoyed my time at the apartment. It’s perfect for 2 or 3 friends who want to be near touristy areas, but not necessarily live in a touristy neighborhood. There are great food options nearby and metro stops are only 15-20 minutes away. Be weary if you carry a lot of luggage, as there’s no elevator and the flat is in the top floor; however, the view from the balcony is beautiful. Amazing hosts and amenities for the price!!

description: Everything you want to explore is right outside the door of this place.

reviews.text:
Great value for money!
For just £40, we got a smart TV, reliable Wi-Fi, hot water for showers, and even a free breakfast included. You really can’t beat the price for what’s offered! Also the host lent me their mobile charger for the night.
However, there were a couple of downsides. The toilet could have been cleaner, as there were some dark brown stains inside. Also, the shower tray leaked. Lastly, it was a bit odd that there wasn’t a kettle in the room for tea or coffee, which is usually a standard amenity in most hotels.
Overall, good stay for the price—just a couple of things that could use improvement!

Great stay right in the heart of Sultanahmet! The location in Fatih is absolutely perfect for exploring all the major historical sights on foot. Mustafa was a fantastic and welcoming host, always quick to respond. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Highly recommended for anyone visiting Istanbul

We had a great stay.
The accommodation is in a perfect location, with everything within walking distance, which is extremely convenient in Istanbul.
The apartment was exactly as described, clean and comfortable.
The staff was very friendly, welcoming, and always kind, which made us feel very at ease during our stay.
We would definitely recommend this place to friends and family, and we would not hesitate to stay here again if we have the opportunity

This is a very smoothly run hotel. Everything was always clean, the breakfast served was always diverse and delicious (with a great view too!) and arriving at the building is easy and welcoming. Mustafa was very helpful and responsive. Excellent location being a short walk to Sultanahmet and the Blue Mosque. The restaurant near my window played the same chill playlist on repeat - didn't bother me much but the songs got old lol. Overall, a very well-serviced stay!

Mustafa was a great host and the concierge at reception was very helpful. The photos provided on this listing were not the ones of the room I stayed in. Instead of a proper queen bed, it was 2 twin mattresses stuck together with a top sheet (not even a fitted sheet).

description: Relax with the whole family at this peaceful place to stay.

reviews.text: Mehmet and Ali were very responsive and direct, and always helped me with the stuff that I needed. The place was clean and good for its price, the location was a walking distance to a supermarket, bus station, sights, ferry station, and so on. I recommend this place.
The location is great. It was smaller than I expected. Bathroom was not really clean. When I am taking a shower door felt down. There were construction work behind the place. I couldn’t sleep at all.

her şey güzeldi iletişim düzgündü ilk başta su soğuk sıkıntısı yaşadık ama aynı gün yardımcı olup düzelttiler, tuvalet kapısının içeriden kolu kırıktı malesef ama sıkıntı etmedik, ev sahibi dost canlısı, klima yepyeni çalışıyor, banyoda eksiklerin hepsi vardı mutfak içinse tava cezve tarzında ufak şeyler yoktu, kettle tencere çatal bıçak kaşık ve elektronik ocak vardı, biz zaten gün içerisinde hep gezdiğimiz için pek uğramadık açıkçası, tekrar gelmeyi düşündüğümüz sakin bir yer her yere çok yakın özellikle lokl güzel kafelere 🤍
Temizdi ve konum olarak güzeldi
oda küçük, fiyat iyi, temizlik yeterli, akaretler içerisinde ama sesli bir yerde değil.

description:

This amazing and spacious 3 bedroom flat is located in the heart of Istanbul. With only 8 min walk to Osmanbey Metro Station and 15 min walk to City's Shoping Mall.

reviews.text:
We stayed 3 nights with our 3 children in this very spacious and well appointed flat. We enjoyed having 3 bedrooms, bedding was comfortable and heating efficient. We were however disturbed by very noisy neighbours (upstairs and downstairs) every night who seemed to be making excessive noise all throughout the night. We raised this with the host (all flats in the building are Air BnBs he manages) who assured us he would warn them but we were unable to enjoy our stay due to the lack of sleep every night. The road is also very noisy.
Apart from this, the listing is conveniently located 10min on foot from the nearest metro station and a short walk to the nearest bakery, supermarket, etc. The host was always very responsive and reactive whenever we got in touch or needed more soap, dishwasher tabs, etc

Abdullah’s apartment in Şişli was an excellent choice for me and my two kids (15 and 20). The location is truly convenient everything we needed was within a few minutes’ walk, which made our trip so easy and comfortable. The bus station is about 4 minutes away, and the metro is around a 10 minute walk, so getting anywhere in Istanbul was simple. We also loved having great bakeries nearby perfect for breakfast and snacks during the day.The apartment itself was exactly what we hoped for: clean, safe, and well equipped with everything we needed for our 6-day stay. It felt comfortable from the moment we arrived, and it was a great home base after long days exploring the city. The building and area also felt secure, which matters a lot. What really made the experience stand out was Abdullah’s hospitality. He made us feel at home and was genuinely attentive and kind. If you’re looking for a place in Istanbul with an amazing host and a great location, , I highly recommend staying here.

I appreciate for the host. We came to spend Christmas as a family. The apartment’s location is nice. You can visit the places nearby. The apartment is clean, spacious, organized. The kitchen is nice, bedrooms and living rooms are nice. There is always hot water available. The apartment is peaceful. The host is very responsive. We are grateful. Great place to stay. Highly recommended!
Everything is Super clean . Exactly as the photos. The building is good . The location is also great. The host is very responsive and friendly . We felt at home

This was a lovely flat, we were impressed instantly. It is very spacious with plenty of beds - all completely comfortable. Very clean and comfortable.
Abdullah was extremely helpful and on the ball. Walkable to great transport and Taksim, however be aware that it is quite hilly around that area.
Great stay great place, thank you

description: This room is a beautifully designed Studio which offers everything you need for a short term stay. The studio offers a private bathroom with shower, a well equipped small kitchenette, a large size tv, free wifi, A.C. and central heating. Free room service once every 2 day and 24 hours doorman makes your stay more comfortable. You can also enjoy your coffee at the 18 hours available information desk while you are getting information about secrets of city or answers of your questions.

reviews.text:
I’m so happy I found these apartments. The location is incredibly convenient - just a 5-mins walk from the heart of Istanbul and the Blue Mosque, yet the area is surprisingly quiet.
My goal was to rest and recover after a long flight and this place was perfect for that. At the same time, I could easily explore the city since everything was within walking distance.
The hosts were extremely kind and responsive. They were always quick to help whenever I needed anything, and they even helped me with my laundry, which I really appreciated.
I would also like to mention there was absolutely no unpleasant smell in the room. It seems that the issue mentioned in some older reviews has been completely resolved. The room smelled fresh, was very clean, and felt comfortable. As a nice bonus, there was a really good hair dryer, which made me happy.
Here, everything you need is provided. The value for money is simply excellent. I highly recommend this place and will definitely stay here next time.

Room was very clean and had everything we needed. Kitchen was also very useful with the necessary utensils. Room was soundproof if you kept the windows closed and the neighborhood was quiet at night, so it's was easy to sleep. Access to a lot of transportation so exploring the city was easy. Supermarket also very close. The host was kind and helpful. I recommend the place 100% and was worth the money. If I ever go back to İstanbul I would probably choose it again ☺️

Very convenient location with friendly and helpful host. The lack of cleanliness and uncomfortable bathroom made the stay much less pleasant than it could have been. There was a constant smell of sewage coming from the bathroom during the whole stay. The host kindly attempted to mediate the situation but unfortunately it was only a temporary fix. The bathroom is small and uncomfortable to use, but that is a limitation of the space available. The best thing about the room is the lighting and wooden planks behind the bed. If only the room were better maintained with more focus on comfort and cleanliness, it could have been a great stay.

I booked on a very short notice and needed to check in really early in the morning, as I’ve just arrived to Istanbul after a 12 hour trip – Erol and Bilal were extremely flexible and helpful! They replied almost immediately and helped me to check in early, which literally saved my day, I’m truly grateful for that. 🙏
The place is a few minutes away from Sultanahmet Mosque, right in the heart of Istanbul. 🕌
Even though it is in such a central location, it’s cozy and peaceful, and looks just like the photos! I can wholeheartedly recommend staying in this cozy downtown hideaway. 🤗

This was a great place for a short-term stay, and I definitely recommend it. It was very clean, easy to access, and had everything needed for a few days. The only downside was that it was a bit small, but considering the price, location, and overall comfort, it was a great experience for me.

description:
Newly Renovated — August 2026

The apartment underwent a comprehensive renovation and maintenance update in August 2026. It has been freshly painted, and all necessary repairs and improvements have been completed. While the décor and character remain the same, maintenance issues mentioned in older guest reviews have been fully addressed. The photos reflect the apartment’s current, renovated condition.

reviews.text:
The place was located a walkable distance from Tophane, Istiklal and Galataport and close to the neighborhoods Cihangir and Karaköy. So the metro and ferry are also pretty close and you don‘t need to spend money on taxis constantly. There are many cute cafes, breakfast houses and restaurants nearby. So the location was pretty good and we felt safe in the airbnb.
The airbnb was clean overall, but there were some hairs and stains on the bedding when we inspected them on arrival and the bed frame of bedroom 1 was dusty and had stains. There was also no shower gel and shampoo in the bathroom as promised on the listing.
The upstairs neighbors are also very loud and you can hear them watching the tv until very late in the night and also some other more intimate bedroom noises. If you‘re a light sleeper, I would recommend bringing ear plugs.
We didn‘t use the kitchen.
I would recommend staying here if the cleanliness is a bit more improved and if you don‘t mind hearing the neighbors.

The location is excellent and very convenient, with plenty of interesting places to explore nearby. There is also a tram stop just a 10-minute walk away.
The apartment was generally clean and comfortable. However, it could use some maintenance. There was visible black mold on the bathroom ceiling, and one of the rooms had a noticeable musty smell. This wasn’t a major issue for us because we spent most of our time exploring the city, but it could be a concern for guests with allergies or respiratory sensitivities.
Communication with the hosts was pleasant and smooth. They also offer the option of arranging an airport transfer.
If you have a late flight, it’s worth discussing luggage storage in advance. We were able to leave our luggage in the apartment until noon, which we appreciated. However, our airport transfer wasn’t until 2:00 PM, and there wasn’t a convenient luggage storage option nearby, so we had to stay close to the apartment with all of our bags until it was time to leave

Nice two-bedroom apartment - very clean and in a central location, with supermarkets, shops, cafés and restaurants all within walking distance and open late. The hosts were very responsive and quickly fixed the hot water issue we had. It's quiet and perfect for a good night's sleep, with powerful AC, fast Wi-Fi, decent beds and a good shower. I would have liked a bit more ventilation in the bathroom, but that's not a major issue. Overall very happy and would recommend.

Amazing value for two ladies on a short trip to Istanbul. The location is ideal, with lots of cafes, restaurants, and bars very close, but not overrun by crowds, and close enough to the major city attractions without needing a car. The place is updated and clean and completely comfortable. Ram was exceptionally responsive for all our inquiries. I would definitely stay here again next time I’m in Istanbul.
Great location, exactly as described, and easy self check-in with clear instructions. The place was clean and well-maintained. Would definitely recommend, especially for the location!

description: Welcome to our cool new stylish 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom home nestled in the vibrant heart of Şişhane. Perfectly situated for both business and leisure travelers, this modern abode offers comfort, convenience, and a taste of local Istanbul living! Comes with A/C, Wifi & Netflix!

reviews.text: Very spacious apartment with all the amenities you need and plenty of storage space. Responsive host. Great locations close to bars and restaurants and very close to metro station. However, it shows age and signs of wear and tear. The photos were taken while ago. Also the pillows were the cheapest synthetic so very uncomfortable. The only weird part from the host was that they asked us to empty the bin, which is unheard of especially when you pay cleaning fee.

I really, really highly recommend this place!
I’ve stayed here with my mum, sister and brother-in-law and we all agree that the place was great.
It’s very well located - a few minutes from the metro station and perfect for getting to various areas of Istanbul.
The host is very responsive and the instructions for self check-in were very clear.
The flat itself is better than expected. Very spacious, well decorated and has a charm. One bedroom comes with an en-suite shower/toilet. It’s spotlessly clean and had all the amenities/toiletries one needs.
Honestly, can’t fault it!
Check it out for yourself.
🌟🌟🌟

We booked right before we were supposed to arrive. Got to check in for free 2 hours before. Nice host who responded quickly, and was clear. The place was clean and nice. Got good slippers, and there was a bottle of water until we arrived. This was extra nice. The place is very central and close to both metro and taksim square. The only thing that was a bit stupid was that the internet didn't reach the bedrooms. All in all, we were happy. We will definitely come back.

Fantastic location 2 min walking to metro and 3 min to tram. 5 min walk to Galata tower and istiklal street. Communications with host was fluent and fast. Host always replied in less than 10 min. Checking into the apartment was very easy. Apartment itself is good and comfortable and everything work good but no WiFi in the bedrooms. Maybe missing a toaster. It’s a very good spot to spend some days in Instambul. Many good restaurants around. And good cafes for breakfast.

I was looking for a apartment to spend New Year with family in Istanbul. The apartment was perfectly matching with my needs. It has big, clean and well equipped kitchen, big dining table and big living room.
The apartment is well located close to Sishane metro station and Historical district of Galata tower. We had no problems going around the city using public transport.
There are few things which may be critical for future guests:
1) The apt is located on the 4th floor of the building in historical city center so there is no elevator and you need to use steps to reach it. We did not have a lot of luggage with us, so it was ok.
2) There is a mosque minaret close to apt, so be ready that few times a day you would hear call for pray.
3) The entrance to the house is located close to the road and you need to be careful and attentive going out or entering building.
In general we enjoyed staying in VNG property apt and I would recommend it to other travelers with no hesitation.

Ev gerçekten mükemmel bir konumda, her yere kolaylıkla ulaşabiliyorsunuz. Dekorasyonu sıcak ve davetkardı; kendimi sanki bir otelde değil, kendi evimdeymişim gibi hissettim. It's one of the best Airbnbs I have ever stayed in. The place is exactly as shown in the pictures, and the amenities are perfect. The hosts are very responsive and friendly. We asked for help twice — once with the heating system and once with the cutlery (which was in the hidden drawer) — and the host responded very quickly and came to help within 3–5 minutes. The place is within walking distance of Acıbadem Station and is close to a free-entry museum.

Overall, the apartment was decent. However, the photos were clearly taken right after a recent renovation, and the place now looks a bit worn.
We had some issues: the toilet wouldn't flush properly and was leaking. To his credit, the owner fixed the flushing problem after we contacted him. He was responsive and easy to reach.
A couple of other things to note: we couldn't find any cutlery (knives, forks, etc.), and there was no laundry detergent, so we had to buy our own.
In conclusion: It's a reasonable option for a large group, as the cost per person becomes quite affordable. However, for two friends needing separate bedrooms, the total price might be a bit high.

This place gave homey vibes and felt like a safe space. Great location for grocery stores, pharmacy and cafes which were only a few minutes away. A nearby trash can was available. Strong WiFi was extremely helpful. Ubers were able to spot the place and park in front of the entrance. We were lucky to find an elevator to carry our luggage and groceries to our apartment.

description:
For those looking to escape the city rush, Merlot Suite offers a serene atmosphere and a delightful terrace 🍇
With its elegant décor and peaceful location, it’s perfect for a romantic getaway or a quiet break 🍷
Located at the junction of Ataşehir and Ümraniye, the apartment is close to the hospital district and the Finance Center, offering a calm retreat with easy access to the city.

reviews.text:
Damla was a very responsive and welcoming host. The place was relatively easy to find, but the location is not the greatest. You are not that close to local attractions or public transportation like Metro or Metrobus.
Cleanliness could be better. We've found a hairball in the shower. There were stains on the sheets and the place was dusty in some areas. It didn't feel deeply cleaned.
Privacy wasn't great as the curtains weren't completely closing the windows. Also the balcony door didn't even have any cover on it. From there the bed is directly visible. Damla was great to offer another apartment for this reason though.
All in all, it's a good stay. But the place didn't justify 65€ for one night. Top level floor with no elevator, lack of privacy, not the greatest location, okay cleaning, watered down soap etc. There are probably better alternatives. Half the price, and it would be a great stay.

We stay one night at this place at it worth every penny! We highly recommend, was nice and clean , comfy mattress/ bed to sleep in and the host very friendly , she gave all the info and recommendations we need it.
Also a lot of restaurant nearby with delicious food!

It was a sweet penthouse. Having air conditioning is a huge advantage. Everything you need has been considered at home, there is a real home comfort. We had a great time, The location was also very good, we were close to everywhere. Damla is amazing host, very helpfull
thank you.
Everything is like they described only problem is apartment dont have elevator and house is located top floor 😇

evin konumu çok iyi. araç parkı için evin önü ve etrafı çok uygun, temizlik ve odanın imkanları son derece yeterli, ev sahibi çok anlayışlı ve ilgili, fiyat performans olarak harika bir seçim, herşey için teşekkürler 🙏

description: Enjoy unforgettable experiences in this unique and family-friendly place. Our place is 1 minute away from Taksim Square and also 1 minute away from the subway. You can easily find 24-hour markets and restaurants around our house. Shopping malls, airport, bus stop are within walking distance, less than 1 minute. Pharmacy is downstairs from our house. Currency exchange office is across from our house. It is a clean and safe place where you can come and stay with your family in peace.

reviews.text: The airbnb had a warm, cozy feel to it. It was clean, check-in was easy and as described in the listing. The host was available to answer all our questions. Great location, easily accessible to Taksim Square, İstiklal Avenue and Galata area. Recommend this listing to others.

We had a great stay, coming back to the apartment always felt like coming home. The living room has a large tv and a super comfy sofa, and we were watching youtube-videos in the evening of what to check out in Istanbul :-) The building has an old and fun elevator that was great for my mom of 85, who is not so good in climbing steps. The flat is practical and inviting, and great with two toilets when you are more people. Two of the bedrooms are spacious, the third room is smaller. The kitchen is functional with a large fridge, and there are small food stalls close by. (Very expensive, so we went to the supermarket instead that was about a 6-7 min walk away.) The flat is quiet and peaceful, quite unbelievable considering it is so close to Taxim square. If you want to stay in a place that has easy access to everything, no steep hills to walk up and down to get home, and close to metro, buses and taxis, this is the place!

The first positive feedback is the host, who is very responsive and friendly, if you share a problem he will try to solve it. We had some issues with bed sheets and kitchen stuff but the host solved them immediately.
Overall the apartment is good for stay and easy access to taksim square with good neighborhood.
The elevator was working and helpful to get access to the third floor, but it is very small lifting with space for two people at a time. All of AC were working. Quiet in the night and safe for walking late.
The only problem we had was bathroom shower, where the water temperature was changing and got cold and hot suddenly without any change! Not a big deal but something to know in advance.

This house is absolutely worth staying in! It’s conveniently located near numerous shops and cafes, with Taksim Square just a short walk away. The host is highly responsive, and the living room and main bedroom are spacious, providing plenty of room for everyone. Best of all, it features a lift, a flat area, and the convenience of washing and drying clothes. We felt right at home with the large TV screen and Netflix!

Apartment is large and located in an older building near Taksim square.
Check in and check out was smooth.
Note that the elevator is extremely small and can only fit one person. WiFi does not always reach all the rooms.
Overall, good value given the location.

description:
Modern Taksim Flat with Private Terrace
Experience Istanbul’s true soul in our cozy attic flat, perfectly located right next to the iconic Museum of Innocence. Just a 5-minute stroll from Istiklal Street and Galatasaray High School, this home offers a central yet authentic setting. Situated on the top floor of a quaint 3-story building with no elevator, it features a beautiful Private Terrace to enjoy the artistic vibe of Cukurcuma. Enjoy effortless access to Galataport and Taksim Square.

reviews.text: We loved our stay at Songul's, apartment. It looked exactly like the photographs, and the location was very convenient to many restaurants, shops, public transportation, and the Galataport. We eventually learned how to get around using the tram, metro, and the funicular, so we avoided the need for taxis as the traffic in Istanbul is quite hectic. But the location was quiet, clean and comfortable after a long day touring the many sites. The hosts were extremely responsive and provided many recommendations. The only downside is the there is no lift (as noted in the listing) and the stairs leading into the apartment and on to the upper deck are quite steep, so probably not suitable for young children or those with mobility issues. But otherwise, we had a lovely stay and really enjoyed this flat and the wonderful neighborhood!

Great funky building and neighborhood that definitely offers a more authentic and local feel. The unit is clean, cozy, and simple, with all the essentials you need for a short, comfortable stay. Private rooftop terrace offered a peaceful retreat for enjoying our morning coffee and relaxing with a nightcap at the end of a long day.
Are there a few narrow steep stairs you’ll have to navigate here, as others mention? Yes. Do they add to the sense of adventure, character, and charm of the space? Absolutely yes, in all the best ways.
Location is perfect. Easily walkable to various local transport options and many additional nearby neighborhoods of interest, with several cool shops and cafes also right at your feet along the surrounding streets. Hosts were very communicative, responsive, and accommodating. Definitely recommend!

Great stay.
The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was convenient, and Nurten was a friendly, responsive, and helpful host throughout my stay. Check-in was smooth, and I felt very welcome. I would happily stay here again and recommend it to anyone visiting Istanbul.

Songül is a great host. She was very helpful in everything. With the advice she gave, my holiday was much more fun and beautiful. I enjoyed staying in this beautiful apartment in Çukurcuma and it exceeded all my expectations.
Communication with Songül was easy and smooth; She was very friendly and always ready to help.
The location is very central, making it easy to explore Istanbul. The Private Terrace is one of the highlights of my stay, and the small size of the flat was no problem thanks to this open-air space.
Everything is within walking distance, including a variety of shops, restaurants and cafes. I especially loved the antique stores and the Innocence museum on the same street. Istiklal Street, Galata Port, Taksim square,Tram and metro stations are just a 3-minute walk away, making transportation in the city very easy.
The apartment itself is clean, comfortable and beautifully decorated. It felt like a home away from home. I highly recommend this place to everyone.

We had a great stay at this Airbnb in the heart of Karaköy, Istanbul! The location is perfect—close to everywhere you’d want to go, including Galataport, local fish restaurants, and lots of great bars, cafes, and shops. The unit itself was clean and comfortable, with a beautiful terrace view overlooking the historic part of the city.
It was the perfect spot to relax after a day of exploring. Songül, the host, was super friendly and responsive, which made everything easy from check-in to check-out. Would definitely stay here again!

The property is currently undergoing construction. Our experience at the Airbnb was a source of concern, as we did not see any other guests and the owner's English language proficiency was limited. A large number of rooms were under renovation. We were taken through an unconventional entrance, which was somewhat unsettling, and our room had no internet connection or phone service. As a result, we were unable to sleep throughout the night. Although our room was equipped with an air conditioner, a remote control was not available. Additionally, there was no extra toilet paper provided, and the room had a strong smell of cigarettes. The bath soap was also insufficient.
