description:
The flat is located on "Ömer Hayyam Caddesi" in Beyoğlu. The street itself is not fancy or touristic — it’s lined with local shops and residences, and it stays lively even after midnight. However, the flat is just 300 meters from the heart of Istanbul, Istiklal Street. In just a few minutes, you can walk to many popular tourist attractions, cafés, restaurants, markets, and more.
You can walk to the Taksim square in 15 minutes, Galata Tower in 19 minutes, Karaköy pier in 27 min (1.8 km)

reviews.text:
The location is excellent - right in the heart of Istanbul, in Beyoğlu. It was very convenient for exploring the city, with plenty of cafes, shops, and attractions nearby.
Check-in was quick and easy. The host was very attentive and stayed in touch throughout our stay, regularly checking if everything was okay and whether we needed anything.
As for the downsides, the apartment was a little less clean than it appeared in the photos, especially the shower area. The toilet also kept running constantly, which was quite annoying. Also, the stairs to the apartment are quite steep and difficult, particularly if you have heavy luggage.
Overall, we had a good stay and especially appreciated the fantastic location and the attentive host.

Great apartment, everything was just like in the photos and description. Comfortable bed, clean, and the WiFi is suitable for work. Good location with many cafes and shops nearby, and it's convenient to get to and from both airports.

Amazing hosts, always respond when I texted, the location is TOP 🥇 - you could easily just walk around Istikal street, less than 10 minutes to Taxim and Galata tower. Very clean apartment and each Sunday there is a small market for fruits - definitely worth visiting it.

Felt right at home in Furkan’s place! Super easy to find as we went there by taxi. Love the fact that it was about a 5 minute walk to Istiklal street! Quite busy with the cars on the road in front of the house but we didn’t mind it at all as we prefer a lively place to a quiet dodgy one. The house has 2 doors to separate the sound from the bedroom so it’s only loud in the living room. Especially appreciated the detailed instructions from Furkan and his responsiveness in our communications. Super close to the bus stops and convenience stores. Found nice eateries nearby and a delicious doner shop right beside the house. Nice cafe in front of the house too! The house is on the first floor and there’s only stairs, but we didn’t mind that either. 10/10 would definitely recommend and would even stay there again if we have the chance :)

Good location, 5-7 mins to Istiklal, in next building cafe without overprice, bus station is near. Flat is big, warm, enough clean, there are all needed things to cook/wash/shower. Only problem, that before 10:00 checkout and after 16:00 checkin. The worst rules I ever met. Everything else was good

description:
Welcome to our stylish and comfortable apartment in Kadıköy, the lively and dynamic center of Istanbul, just 200 meters from the famous Bull Statue! In this unique location, you will be in the heart of city life and at the same time have a peaceful accommodation experience.
Our apartment is on the garden floor and has a large garden surrounded by high walls. The garden has pine, laurel, olive, fig and plum trees. All windows and balcony doors have iron bars.

reviews.text:
Orhun and his father are real hosts. From the beginning we had excellent and fast communication. I got an answer or an instruction for every question. they responded quickly to everything I needed.
The apartment is in a perfect location, in the center of everything, and so peaceful. It has a beautiful courtyard, which gives you the impression that you are not in a big city. Shops, cafes, restaurants are all around us. If you want a quiet walk, run or training outside, you have 3 minutes to the seashore where there is an area for walking, running and many parks with exercise equipment.
The apartment is spacious, clean and has everything you need for a long or short stay. It is the same as in the photos. It feels like home. I will definitely return to this apartment and to this part of Istanbul.
Thank you Orhun 🍀

We stayed in the apartment for one month and really enjoyed it. It was a very liveable space, the kitchen was well stocked, good shower, good bed and the garden was a great, peaceful, place for a cup of tea in the morning - it was better in real life than in the pictures! The location was good too, easy walking distance to Moda, ferries and buses.

Apartment located in the heart of shopping area. Surprisingly, the area is quite private and quiet. Orhun assisted us on what transport to take from the airport and greet us at the apartment. Very responsive to all our queries. The apartment itself is very comfortable, with aircon and heater, microwave, oven, kettle and cooker hob, also washer and dryer. Bedroom is very spacious. Overall, it was pleasant and comfortable stay, lots of local restaurant and cafe around the apartment, 2 mins walk. Local shopping area is located just a street from the apartment. Thank you Orhun for the great accomodation.
Lovely apartment in a great location , everything as described . Lovely to beable to sit outside too and very private . Really enjoyed our stay .
Very nice host and very nice apartment! Always answered messages very quickly. Apartment was clean and had everything you need. Also very central location in Kadiköy, while not being too loud at all.

description:
This special place is close to everything, only 5 minutes to Taksim and makes it easy to plan your trip. It is in a perfect location for transportation. The apartment is in the newest and most prestigious residence of this area. Free indoor and outdoor parking, free pool, sauna, gym and 24/7 professional security service.
All the items in my apartment have been carefully prepared for you, the apartment is perfectly prepared before you arrive for you to have an unforgettable stay here, it is a very clean and unique apartment.

reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay! The place was exactly as described—clean, comfortable .The location was great, and communication with the host was excellent from check-in to check-out. Everything went smoothly.
Thank you for a great experience!

I really enjoyed my stay. The apartment was cozy, clean, and well-equipped. The location was perfect for exploring Istanbul, and I felt comfortable throughout my stay. The host was friendly, helpful, and always quick to respond. Everything went smoothly from check-in to check-out. I would happily stay here again!

Felt like home! 💛
We chose this place because of the amazing reviews about Borak, and they’re absolutely true! He’s such a kind-hearted host who truly cares and goes the extra mile. The apartment was spotless, comfy, and had everything we needed.
Centrally located, with a park and ferry station within walking distance, plus a mosque opposite ,the athaan added such a peaceful touch. The mini-market in the building has almost everything you need, and the staff are lovely.
No need to cook ,try the café downstairs! The chicken wrap was our favourite, and they kindly customised it to our taste (great prices too!).
We felt safe, warm, and so at home… we honestly didn’t want to leave! 🌿✨
Thank you Borak for a wonderful stay, we will return to Istanbul because of you!

It was a real good experience to stay at this swanky house. I felt like im at my own property. Location, surroundings, communication, pool and fitness center, house, clean areas, various kitchen appliances, everything was good enough. If i visit Istanbul again, i will stay here again, thanks for all Burak.

Burak is a fabulous guy with heart of gold. He made us feel so comfortable. We never missed home. His house. Apartment is beautiful, clean and value for money. I would definitely.
Come back again with my family.Every time I come stanbul, I will stay in their apartment

description: Nice well-decorated one bedroom 88m2 apartment, all-equipped, inside a secured residence. There are nearby services and a wonderful park! High speed internet, Live TV application includes worldwide satellite channels, movies, and series. Heating and air-conditioning available. One A/C in the living room and One A/C in the bedroom. Free parking. Grocery store within the residence.

reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay at this suite! It truly felt like home peaceful, clean, and very comfortable. The management was responsive and helpful whenever we had a question. Everything was exactly as described, and we really enjoyed our time here. Thank you again for the great hospitality!

Host was amazing, price was reasonable check in-out processes was so smooth and easy, apartment was so beautiful and very clean, almost had everything in it, the view was beautiful from the window, the whole staff that work in that building complex were friendly, felt safe, comfortable like i was at home, I really would recommend this and definitely will give it another visit soon❤️

I had a wonderful stay. The apartment was very clean and quiet, and the location was excellent, with easy access to nearby services and amenities. The host was very helpful, friendly, and responsive. I really enjoyed my stay and would definitely recommend this place to others.
Great place to stay the apartment is better than photos and clean

We had a very pleasant two-week stay in the apartment in Esenyurt, Istanbul.
The place was fully equipped with everything we needed.
Communication with the host was always friendly and quick, and we felt very comfortable throughout our stay.
The view was beautiful and made our time there even more enjoyable.
Overall, a highly recommended apartment for a relaxing stay in Istanbul!

description: It has everything what you need in a home. Must see tourist attractions, restaurants, bars, supermarkets, pharmacies and public transportation is just 2 min away by feet.

reviews.text:
This was by far 1 of the best stays we’ve ever experienced in all our yrs on Air BnB. To start: the apt. is modern, super clean & has nice decor. The bed’s comfortable and the kitchen’s well equipped (we cooked many days). We liked the design of the shower which provided plenty of hot water.
WiFi was reliable most days, too, as we work remotely, and we were able to watch Netflix simultaneously. There was 1 occasion where WiFi was down, forcing us to work elsewhere. Sarah was thoughtful though and made up for it by providing us a complimentary cruise via the travel agency below.
On that last note: what makes this Air BnB great are the hosts. Sarah & her co-hosts Caio & Gönül are the example of excellent hosting. They always greeted us; checked in periodically; took time to share recommendations and kept us posted of any major updates. They assisted us with transportation to & from the airport, too. We are so grateful for them showing care & talking to us. We are forever grateful!

The place was exactly as shown in the photos. It was close to a lot of the local attractions. There were plenty of restaurants and shops. The area was lively and full of life, yet quiet during night time. The bed was so comfortable.
Just had minor issues with keeping the toilet lid in position as it would not stay fully opened. We informed the host about this and they mentioned that it was a recurring issue and offered to tape the lid to wall.
The place was extremely clean. However, there was an unpleasant smell in the bathroom throughout our stay.

cannot think of a better place to stay in Istanbul if historical sites are your thing. perfect location, i am not sure but I feel in that side this is the only house kn that location. beautiful view of the Blue mosque. walkable distance to all historical sites. Sara was super helpful and responsive. 3 min walk for a small grocery store. restaurants and shops. apartment itself was a gem. fully functional kitchen sofa and netflix and amazon prime was icing on the cake. one small suggestion is to keep hand-wash at the toilet. because I have back pain the bed was little too soft for me. and bedroom window shades cod have been little darker . but overall it was an amazing experience . would love to stay here again. and highly recommend

Our stay at Sara's unit in Istanbul was wonderful! The apartment was clean and comfortable and the location was perfect. We were right across from the Blue Mosque and could walk to many sights, restaurants and public transportation. Sara was very responsive and even arranged transfer from the airport. We would stay here again.

We highly recommend this apartment. We did not deal directly with Sara. But Caio is a fantastic co-host. He provided useful information about the building before we booked and remembered the issues we had raised when we checked in.
Caio welcomed us in person on our arrival and gave us a tour of the apartment From the terrace, he pointed out the attractions in the area. He provided useful recommendations for restaurants etc.
The apartment was in a fantastic location and was very comfortable. Although I can have some mobility issues, I managed the stairs and appreciated that many attractions could be reached without having to navigate the hills of Istanbul.
This apartment would be our first choice for first time visitors to Istanbul. You really are in the middle of it all. We would happily stay here again on any future visits.

description:
Our terrace apartment, which stands out with its modern design and comfortable living space, is an ideal choice for both business trips and urban stays.
It is a 4-5 minute walk to the Güzelyurt Metrobus stop and only 4 stops to the TUYAP Fair Center.
It is a few steps away from the bazaar, market and daily needs and is centrally and safely located.
It offers a comfortable stay with a queen size bed, air conditioning and a fully equipped kitchen.
Contactless check-in is available.
IDENTIFICATION is mandatory.

reviews.text: I enjoy the stay . Easy connectivity by public transport, near to main highway, peaceful area , many super market and marmra shopping mall at walking distance, apartment is neat and clean with fully equipped kitchen, only ceiling height is low , host is super lady , very much supportive .. VALUE FOR MANEY
Everything was great. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was very kind and responsive. Thank you for the wonderful stay!” ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Lora was an amazing host, very responsive and very helpful!
Her apartment was clean had everything mentioned and was very close to transportation, the metro bus was a 4min walk away and it connected me to everything! The view from the terrace was a beautiful city view. Thank you for hosting me🙏🏻💗

Everything was as it was described on the website. She was really kind and responsive.
It really felt like home. And the Terrace was outstanding beautiful view calm and peaceful.

Sorunsuz bir şekilde giriş yaptık, ev temiz ve sıcaktı. Metrobüse oldukça yakın bir yer, Beylikdüzü içindeki diğer seçeneklere göre bu avantajıyla öne çıkıyor. Tavsiye ederim. Lora Hanım'a teşekkürlerimi sunuyorum 👋

description: Step into the charm of history in this beautifully preserved Galata apartment, where breathtaking Golden Horn views meet timeless elegance. Nestled on a quiet street yet moments from Galata Tower, it offers the perfect balance of tranquility and central convenience. Explore vibrant Istiklal Street, trendy Karaköy, and lively Taksim Square—all within easy reach. A true retreat blending history, comfort, and an unbeatable location.

reviews.text:
Apartment is in prime location with beautiful views over the golden horn.
It has plenty of space and very good ac.
Host is amazing, very responsive, trying to resolve the issue that you might have.
Although, apartment needs some love. Has some stains, some dust, or in visible areas, but under the bad (lost an earring so took a glimpse).
Shower sink seemed stuffed, water was going out very slowly, so you have to be quick with shower.
Kitchen equipment is fine, but missing some parts and essentials, but that’s ok as you have plenty of restaurants.
There was the issue with the noise after midnight that came out of cocktail bar nearby. Although, host investigated and last night was super quiet, it did affected us. But host was very kind to suggest a solution.
All in all worth the money spent, but needs some maintenance.

I had a fantastic experience staying at this apartment! The location is perfect - close to all the main attractions, cafes, and public transport. The place was exactly as described: clean, stylish, and very comfortable. The bed was great, and the AC worked perfectly, which was a big plus during the summer heat.
The host was incredibly responsive and helpful, offering great local tips and making check-in super easy.
Highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul!

Beutifully decorated apartment, with nice wooden flooring in a great location. Close enough to the heart of beyoglu, but just away from it to not be in a very noisy place. The view is stunning (which makes the 5 sets of stairs to get to it worth it). Yigit was very responsive when we had a brief lapse in wifi connection he was able to solve it immediately. Would definitely recommend!

Great communication from the host, very responsive and checkin/checkout instructions were clear.
The area is a great location, lots of cafes, supermarkets nearby. Flat was exactly as described.
Thanks, would stay again.

We spent a weekend in Yigits place and their recommendations really helped us navigate around in very touristic area. Communication was very good, place is nice and have a lotof necessary amenities. Climbing stairs to the apartment after hard day of walking is quite exhausting, so if you arent ready for that, it will be painful :D

description: Enjoy a simple and comfortable stay in this centrally located quiet place. With the public transportation options right next to this cute apartment, you will be able to easily reach Taksim, Sultanahmet, Hagia Sophia, Galata Tower and many other attractions…❤️🏡

reviews.text: Tarik was really helpful and friendly - he was always available and has been a very good host! The apartment was as described and showed in the pictures. It could have been a little bit more clean - but all in all I felt comfortable and the apartment is definitely worth the price! Unfortunately the internet connection did not work for my devices - which was a little unfortunate as I was in Istanbul for work. Tarik was trying to fix it, which did not work - but therefore I found a nice café with Wifi, so it was not such a big problem!

Wonderful host — incredibly kind, responsive, and thoughtful.
The apartment has everything we needed: good Wi-Fi, strong shower with unlimited hot water, great AC, and even laundry detergent was provided.
Water in the fridge was a nice touch.
Location is great — tram and buses stops nearby, and just 5 minutes to a lovely riverside park. There’s also a simple local eatery with a great view close by.
Just a note: Trash bins are right outside, and garbage is collected twice a day — with windows open, it can be noisy. Also, the windows face other buildings and it's very sunny, so we kept the blinds closed. Also when someone from upper floor walks you can hear each of their steps.

Fantastic stay!
The apartment was incredibly convenient, clean, and comfortable. The neighborhood is quiet and charming, perfect for a relaxing stay. The host was wonderful: super friendly, welcoming, and helpful throughout. Highly recommend!

Tarik is an incredibly nice and hospitable host!
Regarding the apartment: It has everything you need, most importantly a working AC. The floors are uneven and walls are very thin, if you have trouble sleeping with any kind of noise, this is something to be mindful of. It is located in a more traditional local neighborhood, off the tourist-path, which can be great for a more authentic experience and it is still very central, so easy to reach all the typical tourist spots. Again, something to be mindful of though, depending on what you want.
All in all, I think value for money is quite good.

It's me again! I decided to extend my stay in this yellow house. Tarik is such an amazing host! He always will make sure that you're comfortable during your stay and very fast reply. The room has everything you want with a tiny kitchen area where you can cook with all condiments As I said again the location is pretty nice close to every transportation bus, tram, and boat across to the Asia side. I recommend it to everyone and I will come again for my next trip. Thanks again Tarik❤️🇹🇷

description: Escape to a serene retreat in the heart of Cengelkoy where modern comfort meets historic charm. This spacious 3-bedroom, 1.5-bathroom villa offers a unique blend of relaxation and convenience, perfect for families, groups, or remote workers looking for a tranquil getaway. Book now for an unforgettable stay in one of Istanbul’s most picturesque neighborhoods!

reviews.text:
The things I loved:
Uskurar is great, close to the water, house can see water from the top floor. Grocery and a mosque very near by < 5 min walk. Great shops. restaurants, coffees very near by. Private parking garage and lovely garden. Clean and spacious place. Quiet neighborhood. Kitchen is fully equipped
Needs improvement:
- would be great if AC in the main floor and additional fan in the summer.
- A bathroomin the main
- Better bed in the main floor.
- Prayer matt (s) (since many guests are muslims)
- Need hot-plate holder for the kitchen.
- Some kitchen towels.
I very much enjoyed my stay and the owners were very nice, generous and responsive. I felt great.

Ground floor house was ideal for us as we have 2 young kids and were staying 3.5 weeks.
We loved the location. Cengelkoy is a great neighbourhood - it has its own neighbourhood vibe and you can reach Uskudar port area and European side easily.
The house was as described and the check-in info (they sent videos of how to use all key appliances) was appreciated to overcome language barrier (I don’t speak Turkish).
Communications were good, always responsive. The cleaner they sent was good too.
Things to bear in mind:
- if you’re coming in summer it’ll be hot in the rooms which don’t have A/C. The fans they provide help, but still (night temperature in Istanbul remains in mid 20s).
-one of the electrical circuits needs looking at as it was tripping the mains so ask them about that in advance.
- the sofas on the lower ground level are more akin to outdoor style as the pads separate. Not an issue for us as we weren’t sitting there much.
- no microwave.

I enjoyed my stay here so much and I can talk about it for hours. But for the sake of the review. Here are key points: amazing location, quick walk to Cengelkoy. 2 car garage parking available. Beautiful garden and a stunning terrace with Bosphorus view. It was a bit cold in the dining area but I’m sure that can be fixed. Looking forward staying here again. Special thanks to Berril from VNG.

Alt katta salon ve mutfak olmasına rağmen evde belirgin bir rutubet kokusu vardı. Halbuki bunlar evde en çok vakit geçirilen alanlar. Çarşafların üzerinde de saçlar vardı ve ev uzun süredir boş kalmış gibi görünüyordu. Klimayı çalıştırdığımızda farklı kokular da fark ettik. Açıkçası evin yeterince temiz olduğunu düşünmüyorum.
Ayrıca klimadan su damlıyordu. Alt kattaki yatakta kimsenin rahatça uyuması mümkün değil çünkü oda çok sıcak ve klima yok. Sadece bir vantilatör konulmuştu ama havanın sıcaklığı nedeniyle pek işe yaramıyordu.
Bahçe de maalesef haşerelerle doluydu. Dışarıda biraz oturalım dedik ama sinekler her yerimizi ısırdı. Genel olarak hiç memnun kalmadık ve kesinlikle önermiyorum.
Böyle bir deneyim yaşamayı biz de istemezdik. Keşke ev daha düzenli kullanılan ve her misafir çıkışından sonra temizlenen bir yer olsaydı. Açıkçası bu evin uzun süredir boş kaldığını ve düzenli bakım/temizlik yapılmadığını düşünüyorum. Hatta ev satışa çıkarılmış.

Evin konumu çok iyi. Ayrıca hemen bildirimlere geri dönüyorlar bahçe olmasında çok iyi tabi denize yakın olması evin biraz eski olmasından dolayı biraz alt kat biraz rutubet kokuyor ama mobilyalar gayet yeni 2 günlük konaklama için bulaşık deterjanı sabın gibi unsurları bırakmaları çok iyi . İstanbul’a gelip eski semtleri görmek dskş İstanbul’u hissetmek istiyorsanız bu ev tam size göre ❤️

description:
This stylish and comfortable studio room, located in the center of Taksim, offers you a pleasant accommodation experience. Our room has a double bed, a private bathroom and modern amenities.

You can relax with amenities such as free WiFi, air conditioning and 24-hour hot water. Markets, restaurants and shopping spots are just a few steps away. You can reach Taksim Square in 3 minutes on foot and go anywhere in Istanbul easily by public transportation.

reviews.text:
The accommodation has an excellent location, with very easy access to different types of transportation, all within a 10-minute walk, and very close to Taksim Street. The connection to the rest of the city is very convenient. As a woman traveling alone, I felt safe at all times, both in the neighborhood and inside the accommodation, which I really appreciated.
The place is comfortable, clean, and functional. It is small, but well organized and cozy. I had a small issue with the shower on the first day because I didn’t fully understand how it worked, but afterward I was able to use it without any problems and enjoy the hot water.
Check-in was very flexible, which made everything easy and comfortable. The host was very kind, attentive, and always willing to help. On the first day, he and his wife welcomed me with a Turkish coffee, a lovely gesture that made me feel very welcome from the beginning.
Overall, it was a very positive, comfortable, and safe experience. recommend this place.

The reception was more than wonderful. I was warmly welcomed with a cup of Turkish coffee and water. The room was very clean, with a large bed and a clean bathroom. The location is very close to Taksim Metro Station, and there are many shops and restaurants nearby. The location is excellent, and my brother, Muhammad, was wonderful in his responsiveness and hospitality. He is a very helpful and humble person, quick to respond to your needs. I will definitely return and recommend everyone to book this wonderful accommodation.

The room was very clean and well prepared. Even though I arrived quite late at night, everything was ready, which made me feel very comfortable. Mehmet Bey and his wife were incredibly kind, warm, and helpful throughout my stay. The place was exactly as shown in the photos, and I had a very pleasant experience overall. I felt safe and comfortable, and I would definitely recommend this place to others.

Mehmet's place is essential and very practically located to be on the road all day around Istanbul. Would recommend for solo travels, less for couples because it's a bit tiny. Overall, I had a good experience and I was kindly welcomed. Cleanliness was very good and everything provided (sheets, slippers etc.) was new and fresh. There are some rather minor issues, like the fact that the window faces a wall where birds made there best, but it's definitely good value for money.

I enjoyed my short stay here. The cleanliness was exceptional, the bathroom is very new; plenty of hot water and the owners are very kind and friendly. On a cold rainy day Mehmet texted to tell me the AC unit was set to heat, which made the room very cosy.
The room is suitable for one person, close to Taksim Square, restaurants and grocery stores. The window faces a wall so there's not alot of sunlight but this was fine since I was out all day.
The negative reviews are from previous owners - Mehmet has been operating the hotel since Feb 2025. I would stay here again because I felt they really took care of me and it was the cleanest place I stayed in a month in Turkey.

description: Located in the heart of Asmalımescit, this stylish, modern and original room combines comfort and aesthetics. It offers a unique atmosphere with carefully designed wooden details, warm lighting and artistic touches. Just a 1-minute walk to Istiklal Avenue and a 3-minute walk to the subway, this private room provides the perfect accommodation experience for those who want to feel the energy of the city.

reviews.text: Great stay! Everything was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location in Beyoğlu was perfect, and the host was friendly, responsive, and very helpful. I would definitely recommend staying here!

her şey çok güzeldi, yatak, yastık her şey çok rahattı. metroya inanılmaz yakın. tek sıkıntı interneti bazen yavaşlıyor, bir şeyler izlerken dondu. onun dışında temiz düzenli ve çok güzel dizayn edilmiş. kesinlikle tercih edebilirsiniz.

harika design edilmiş bir oda. 4 gün kaldık ve çok rahat ettik. yatak çok rahat ve büyük. oda tertemizdi. konumu heryere yakın. civarda çok güzel mekanlar vardı. çalışanlar çok güler yüzlü ve yardımseverdi. kesinlikle tekrar ziyaret ederim.

Loved our stay at this boutique hotel! Amazing location, quiet street in a lively part of town, close to the Galata Tower, the tram and ferry stops. Very kind and attentive hosts as well. I only wish we could’ve stayed longer!
The accommodation is very close to Taksim square. There’s a lot restaurent nearby. Can walk to Gelata tower. The host very helpful and friendly. We’re loved this place! Recommended to stay!

description: This stylish place is close to must-see destinations.

reviews.text: The place was big enough and easily accessible. The communication with the host was also fine. But the room was smelling like cigarettes. The elevator was for some time out of service. The fire alarm started to ring very early in the morning, and kept alarming for two hours, we had to wake up super early and couldn’t fall asleep again.

Great stay, convenient location for the airport with a few places to eat around. It’s not central Istanbul but it’s just what you need for a short stay near the airport.

the staff was very helpful and kind

description:
A cozy and stylish apartment steps from Istiklal Avenue!
Located on the 3rd floor (note: no elevator), this charming flat in the heart of Beyoğlu is just a short walk from cafés, shops, major sights, and metro lines. It features air conditioning, a private balcony, and all essentials for a comfy stay—perfect for couples or solo travelers.

Enjoy self check-in via a secure key box for a smooth, flexible arrival.
Modern, central, and welcoming – your ideal base in Istanbul.

reviews.text:
I really enjoyed my stay!
The apartment was super clean and exactly as described. The location was perfect — just a short walk to Istiklal Street, with plenty of shops and restaurants nearby. The bed sheets were very clean, the kitchen was well equipped, and the bathroom was tidy and comfortable. Check-in was smooth and easy.
The only thing to keep in mind is that the apartment is on the third floor and the stairs are quite narrow, so carrying luggage can be a bit challenging. It would’ve been nice to know this beforehand.
Overall, a great stay — I’d definitely recommend it!

We stayed for 7 nights: it was a good geographical point for explorations of Istanbul, especially for the month of March.
A few things to note, though:
1. The flat is upstairs and is reachable through a narrow staircase; at one point the ceiling is very low, you need to bend to pass. Maybe a challenge with heavy suitcases and for tall people.
2. The room is smaller than you can expect from the photos, there is really little space between the bed and the wall on one side. And the bathroom is tiny, although quite comfortable.
3. It was cold and rainy, the room felt quite warm; but it may get very hot when it's sunny, especially in the kitchen-space.
4. The mattress is firm and stable, this is a big plus-point. The linen is clean, but feels synthetic.
5. The location is quite good in terms of transportation, reaching the centre, eateries and shops. The small street is quiet, but can be muddy or dusty, depending on the weather.

I had a wonderful stay at this apartment! It was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location is great, and everything I needed was close by. The host was very friendly and responsive, which made the experience even better. I would happily stay here again!”

This studio apartment was the perfect base for our trip to Istanbul. Located a short walk from Istiklal Street, it made exploring the city easy. Despite being central, it's in a quiet spot, so we rested well without noise issues. The interior is beautifully designed — compact, yet thoughtfully arranged. Ideal for two people. The bed was comfortable, and the space felt warm and welcoming. We appreciated the well-equipped kitchen, which allowed us to cook a few meals. The Wi-Fi was strong and reliable, which was great since we needed to work online. The air conditioning worked perfectly, keeping the apartment cool on warm days. The host was responsive, friendly, and provided clear check-in instructions and local tips, which made everything smooth. Overall, a great place for anyone wanting to be close to the city’s heart while enjoying the comfort and convenience of a well-run Airbnb. Highly recommended!

As a host myself, I understand how important ratings are, so I genuinely wanted to leave max score. Unfortunately, the cleanliness and maintenance were disappointing.
Upon arrival, I found hair everywhere - floor, bed, walls. The towels and the bed sheets were old and worn, there was no coffee, the shower and shower enclosure were damaged, there was a noticeable sewage smell from the bathroom, and the toilet had heavy limescale buildup that looked very unhygienic.
The housekeeping was THE issue. A dirty bucket of water and a mop were left in the hallway throughout my stay, and the dryer was still full of bed linen from previous guests. It felt as though the apartment had not been properly prepared. I would honestly rate the cleaning service 0.
The apartment itself was beautifully furnished though, every centimeter of the space was well optimised.
This property has great potential but the host needs to address the cleanliness and the maintenance issues.
All the best,
Zhani

description: Keep it simple at this peaceful and centrally-located place.

reviews.text:
The apartment is in a good location and the house itself is quite nice. However, there were several issues during my stay. The TV remote didn’t work properly, and although the host replaced it, the problem persisted. The Netflix app also wasn’t functioning — the host promised to assist or provide a contact, but never followed up.
There was no hot water for nearly three days. I had to go to his other apartment downstairs and fix the water heater myself. The bathroom consistently had a bad smell, which made it uncomfortable. Additionally, the microwave wasn’t working, and the host told me to take one from the downstairs apartment — something I also had to handle entirely on my own.
Overall, while the location is great, the lack of proper maintenance and follow-up support made the experience frustrating.

I was very happy to stay in a clean and cozy place that offered a kitchen and a washing machine. However, the air conditioner didn’t work for our entire stay (2 nights and 3 days). We communicated this to the host, and at first he was considerate, explaining that someone could come to fix it the second day of our stay since we had checked in on a Sunday and he couldn’t find anyone available. He told us a repair person would arrive at 10:30am on Monday (the only full day we had in Istanbul to sightsee), so we waited—but no one came. I informed the host, and he said they were running late and asked us to leave the key out for them. However, I was uncomfortable leaving the key, especially with all our belongings inside. The host said we could arrange for someone to fix it that evening when we returned, but to our surprise, no one showed up. I kept messaging the host for updates but eventually gave up when he ignored my messages. It was hotter inside the apartment than outside.
Great place to stay.Clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was friendly and helpful. Highly recommended.

Acceptable apartments at an affordable price. Be prepared for the fact that the photos were taken a long time ago and now the apartment looks a little "tired". However, for a short trip, when you need to stay in a quiet area near the center, this is a good option.

description: Galya Villas is a luxurious accommodation option surrounded by nature in Istanbul Silivri Çantaköy. The villa has 2 double beds, 2 single beds, a large living room sofa set and a fully equipped kitchen and all white appliances. It is located 15 minutes from the center of Silivri, 40 minutes from Istanbul New Airport, 20 minutes from Çorlu Airport and 5 minutes from Silivri beaches. The front and back gardens are covered with grass; there is a seating area in the front garden and a dining table in the back garden. Our luxury villa has an alarm system.

reviews.text: Güven Bey’in villasında çok güzel bir konaklama geçirdik. Villa oldukça temiz, düzenli ve rahattı. Konumu da çok güzeldi ve ulaşım açısından gayet iyiydi. Güven Bey ilgili ve yardımcı bir ev sahibiydi. Her şeyden çok memnun kaldık. Gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederiz. Tekrar yolumuz düşerse kesinlikle yeniden tercih ederiz.

Harika bir konaklama deneyimiydi! Ev hem son derece temizdi hem de tüm detaylar düşünülerek döşenmişti, kendimizi evimizde gibi hissettik. Konum olarak oldukça güzeldi. Overall the value for money is really good. The location is convenient and you can find everything you need around without being in the personally less attractive Taksim mahallesi. The host was kind, responsive, and always ready to help with any questions. Overall, it felt like a home away from home. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to others

The accommodation is simple but everything is clean and quite comfortable, the bed in the bedroom is comfortable, the living room is okay, some uncomfortable things, when you lifting your suitcase upstairs on foot) Simple but comfortable apartment. Booked it because of the 5 star rating but the flat itself was not it. Its not too clean, and could use some general cleaning done, the walls were a but dirty and the toilet worked a little too loud and weak.

description: Your family will be close to everything when you stay at this centrally-located place.

reviews.text: I enjoyed my stay in this apartment. The location is very good just 5 to 7 min walk to taskim square. The security is good as well as I stayed with my family no concerns. The apartment itself is really good as described and shown in pictures and cleaness was very high standard. Enjoyed my time living here do consider this place specially with families. The host was very approachable as well guided the check in and check out instruction and also helped my family to check in .

We had a great stay and really appreciated how flexible and accommodating the host was, especially with arranging an early check-in. Communication was smooth throughout our stay, and any questions or requests we had were addressed quickly.
The location is excellent, very close to Taksim Square and with easy access to many of Istanbul’s main tourist attractions, while still being tucked away on a quiet and safe street.
The kitchen could be a little better equipped, but we were still able to prepare a few meals during our stay. Overall, a comfortable and convenient place with a responsive and helpful host. We would happily recommend it!

Our family reunion of 6 people went very well at this property. Everyone was comfortable in their private rooms, and the living room was large enough for us to hang out and celebrate New Year's. However, I would like to first and foremost complement the host, Bertan. He was extremely helpful and responsive. He helped organize the shuttle for half of our group, and he sent a plumber to fix a clogged bathroom immediately when we discovered the issue. It really felt like he went above and beyond.
The property is located very conveniently. You are separated from the busy touristy area by a large road. On the one hand, that means you have to cross it every time you venture to eat a kebab. On the other hand, there is no chaos around the place itself, but you still have a supermarket, a Starbucks, and some other smaller bakeries and cafes nearby.
We would visit again!

A great location, close to a metro station and Istiklal St. The host was responsive and easy to communicate with. The apartment was super clean and looked as the pictures and description. We loved and enjoyed our stay. Highly recommended.

The location is good, close to Istiklal. The apartment is spacious and warm (except for the far room). Listing was detailed and checkout instructions were clear.
Our first night was fine, but the last two were spoiled. We noticed old water stains on the ceiling upon arrival but didn't pay attention until it rained. Then, the ceiling leaked in several spots across different rooms. We spent our time with buckets instead of resting. Clothes in one room ended up smelling strongly of dampness and wet plaster. The host’s attitude was disappointing: he completely ignored my specific message asking to resolve the issue or offer an alternative.
Host only reappeared at checkout, acting surprised and claiming it was the 'first time' this happened, which felt dishonest given the pre-existing stains. Initially, he blamed management and refused compensation, but eventually provided a partial refund which appeared to be rather symbolic. Other signs of negligence: broken bathroom locks, torn towels.

description:
Welcome to our little corner of Istanbul, a lovingly two BR home where you'll wake up every morning to breathtaking Bosphorus views.
Getting around couldn't be easier. Tram stop is just a minute away, taking you Hagia Sophia, and the city's best museums in 15 minutes. Galataport, one of Istanbul's favorite spots for food and culture, is only 5 minutes away.
Come back after a day of exploring, kick off your shoes, and lose yourself in the colors of the Bosphorus from the comfort of your own home.

reviews.text:
This isn’t my first stay at one of Umut’s apartments, and every time has been an amazing experience. The hospitality is always great and the flat is spotless, super clean, and really comfortable. I had only planned to stay a few days but ended up extending, it just felt right.
The Bosphorus view is honestly next level, probably the best I’ve ever had from an apartment. The location is perfect too: just steps away from Findıklı tram station, Galataport, and the Beşiktaş ferry (ideal for crossing to the Asian side). Beyoğlu is also right there, one of the most lively areas in Istanbul.
The building itself is on the famous “staired street,” which has become a social media hotspot. Inside, the apartment has everything you need, a fully equipped kitchen, modern appliances, and strong AC that kept the place comfortable throughout. As someone who works remotely, I’d definitely come back here for a long-term stay, especially thanks to the high-speed reliable Wi-Fi connection.

The view alone is worth booking here. Walkable distance to Taksim, Galata, Dolmabahçe and İstiklal caddesi. Tram station right nearby that will take you into Eminönü and Sultanahmet for major historical sites. Delicious pastries at Elif'li bakery and chocolatier nearby. You can see Üsküdar, with the massive new mosque and tower from the unit, watch the delicate choreography of thousands of ships pass through the straight. Kız Kulesi (Maiden's Tower) is visible across the strait, as is the Florence Nightingale museum and the largest of the Prince's Islands. Galataport is nearby if you're into that. Just open up the map mode in the Wikipedia app and you'll find museums, architecture, mosques, churches and synagogues all within reasonable walking distance. Unit is well furnished and equipped, tastefully decorated. Umut is a great and proactive host who can recommend local food or facilitate water delivery, etc. Would absolutely stay again. Thanks for making my experience so magical.

Apartment with an incredible view of the Bosphorus! It has everything you need for a comfortable stay. Nearby you’ll find a promenade, restaurants, cafés, and grocery stores, as well as a metro station and a ferry pier. You can quickly reach the city center by tram, take the funicular to Taksim, go by ferry to Üsküdar, or walk to Galataport. The apartment is located on a staircase street, but the hosts were very kind and helped us carry our suitcases up and down the steps. Umut was always available and assisted with everything. Many thanks for the warm hospitality!

Perfect location! The unit is a flat on the 5th floor of an apartment building. There’s an elevator that goes to the 4th floor. There’s some steps from the road to the front entrance that’s worth noting; probably about 50 steps.
The apartment has wonderful views of the Bosporus. It’s conveniently located at the T1 tram stop and the ferry terminal is a short walk. We used the tram everyday, they run every few minutes.
Umut was very helpful and responsive. We would highly recommend this AirBnB! We had a wonderful stay.

Umut’s place has an incredible view of the bosphorus that is very hard to get even in expensive hotels. The space looks exactly like the photos and we had no issues. Umut was a great host, always helpful and responsive.

description:
Our flat is just 5 minute to famous Galata Tower karaköy and Istiklal Avenue where you can find the best restaurants, cinemas, pubs, gift shops, shopping centers of Istanbul. It is also the main street around Taksim and In addition, it is only 2 munites to Galata Bridge and Karaköy tramway and there are also nice fish restaurants and coffee shops under the Galata bridge. very close to şişhane and golden horn metro station.

reviews.text: Samet’s place was incredibly clean and spacious. The tv is huge and couch is comfortable. Excellent location in Taksim Square. It's a little small but it is definitely a comfortable place to stay. The huge bathtub was exactly what we needed after all the running around in Istanbul. Close to metro and a ton of shopping. Lovely and sweet community cats greeted us with purrs and affection whenever we left and returned. Excellent place!

description: My apartment is located on the street adjacent to Istiklal Street. It is also on the same street as the famous French Street. Our neighborhood (Galatasaray) is a train-like place with many nice cafes and restaurants. All major tourist attractions can be reached within minutes from the apartment. This spacious space has 4 Bedrooms and 1 Bathroom, making it rare among Istanbul apartments. Our building is a protected historical monument with characteristic high ceilings.

reviews.text:
Great price-performance apartment in an amazing location. The place has four rooms and a nice dining area, which was perfect for spending time together. It’s very close to many cafes and restaurants, only a 5-minute walk to Istiklal Street, and within walking distance to Galata Tower and Taksim Square. The beds were also very comfortable.
Even though we arrived quite late for check-in, the host was very responsive and everything was perfectly prepared for us when we arrived. The whole experience was smooth and easy. Highly recommended!

Great value for money. The apartment has 4 bedrooms, which is perfect for groups. Very close to Istiklal Street and within walking distance to many restaurants and cafés. The kitchen and dining table are more than sufficient for daily use. Beds are very comfortable and we had a great sleep. Overall, an excellent location with a perfect balance of comfort and price. Would definitely stay again.

This apartment was absolutely wonderful! 🏡 Spacious, clean, and beautifully decorated — perfect for families or groups with its four comfortable rooms. The dining area has a warm, elegant atmosphere, and the kitchen is fully equipped with everything you could possibly need. We really appreciated the complimentary coffee, water, soda, and chocolate — such a nice touch! ☕🍫💫
The location is unbeatable — just a 5-minute walk to İstiklal Street, surrounded by countless cafes, restaurants, and shops. Everything is so easy to reach, yet the apartment itself is quiet and cozy. It truly felt like a home away from home. Highly recommend this place! 🌟

We had a great stay here. The location was definitely one of the best parts — close to Taksim, with plenty of restaurants, shops, cafés, and things to do nearby. It made getting around Istanbul really easy, especially for a group like ours.
The place was comfortable, spacious enough for our group, and had everything we needed for our stay. The host was also helpful and responsive whenever we needed anything.
Overall, a convenient and enjoyable stay, especially if you want to be close to the action in Taksim and explore Istanbul easily. Definitely a solid choice for a group.

The house is truly spacious and comfortable. Having four bedrooms is a huge advantage, especially for large groups, and the dining area is also very pleasant for spending time together. The location is fantastic; it's a 5-minute walk to Istiklal Street. It's surrounded by cafes and restaurants, everything is within easy reach. The house is clean, tidy, and everything you need has been thought of.

I highly recommend this place and would definitely stay here again!
Very nice apartment in the Bakırköy neighborhood and amazing host. If we come back to the area, we’ll stay there again for sure.

The best experience ever beautiful place very clean The host is amazing and would like to help you with everything the view was one of the best very modern can’t wait to be there soon

We had a great time with our family there, the views are breathtaking and the lay out of the apartment is perfect , the neighborhood is also very walkable and lots of shops and restaurants around. We had two minor complaints 1- the bidet in one of the bathrooms was not working 2- I wish there were more dishes and cutlery available

description: Stay in Asmalımescit in an apartment that combines the character of a historic building with modern-day comfort. Bars, restaurants, lively nightlife, and Istiklal Street are just a short walk away, offering easy access to the city’s vibrant atmosphere. Metro and tram stops, along with cafés, art galleries, and music venues, are all within walking distance.

reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay here with our family. The apartment was exceptionally clean, including the bed sheets, towels, kitchen utensils, and all the amenities. It was obvious that great care had been taken to prepare the place for guests.The location is excellent just a short walk from the metro station, making it easy to reach anywhere in the city. It is also right on İstiklal Avenue, surrounded by shops, restaurants, and famous attractions like Galata Tower.The hosts were warm, welcoming, and very responsive. They replied quickly to our questions and were always helpful.There were only two minor downsides. Beds had exposed screws on the side, which could be dangerous, so we covered them with a pillow. Also, the restaurant across the street had live music almost every night until around 1–2 a.m. It was enjoyable at first, but sometimes we wished for a quieter night.Overall, we had a great stay and would gladly recommend this apartment.

Very comfortable, in a great location as well. Photos match the place, entry is a bit funny as you have to squeeze between two restaurants. Door can be tricky to get in but after you get it once it’s easy. I would stay here again to explore Istanbul, great stay!

We really enjoyed our stay at Şeyma’s place. The location is great, surrounded by many restaurants and bars to choose from. Also very close to Galata tower and many shops. The interior is very comfortable and clean. Highly recommend staying here if you are looking for a nice place in the heart of Beyoğlu.

What an incredible place to stay. The location is absolutely amazing, so close to everything you need and makes you feel right at the heart of the action.
Of course it can be quite lively on the street, but that's just what Istanbul is, especially Galata. So if you're picky about street noise, then don't book this place.
The apartment was very comfortable and we will most likely book the same place when we come back in June.

I really, really liked this apartment; it feels warm and homey. The only thing that disappointed me was that the walls and doors weren't very clean. If that were fixed, the apartment would be perfect.I would also like to warn people who are very sensitive to noise: there is a restaurant across the way that plays live music—including loud drums—until 3 or 4 a.m. This made it very difficult to sleep. However, I really liked the apartment itself; it is beautiful and cozy.
