reviews.text:
Anyone considering staying here should know that this is a very crowded and unclean area of Istanbul, though there are cleaner, more pleasant areas nearby with easy access to public transportation.
The apartment and building smelled strongly of cat urine, and there was cat feces in several areas. The host did not disclose that the elevator was out of order, despite the apartment being on the fourth floor with a narrow spiral staircase. The washing machine is also shared, and we couldn't use it upon arrival because someone else was already using it.
The apartment looks much nicer in the photos than it actually is, and even the advertised view is misleading—the actual view is mostly blocked by surrounding buildings.
The host was not rude, but I personally felt uncomfortable in the apartment and did not get a good feeling from the space. My main issue is that important details that would have been dealbreakers for me were not disclosed upfront. Guests should be given accurate information

Right in the centre of bars and restaurants which was really convenient! Though I recommend bringing earplugs especially on the weekend.
Super clean and tidy, really comfortable bed and great communication from the host.
We didn’t mind it, but be aware that this Airbnb is on the top floor with a broken elevator.
Overall a great place to stay!
Temiz ferah ev konum çok basit

It's right in the heart of Kadikoy, and I loved experiencing all of the town while staying here. If u are not bothered with stairs, you can experience the best sunset view of the whole Istanbul. Really nice stay, good price. Loved it.

Gündoğdu bey çok iyi bşr ev sahibi, herşey yazıldığı ve fotolarda görüldüğü gibiydi, temizlik ve hijyen çok iyiydi, klima çalışıyordu, olması gerrken tüm imkanlar vardı, çok memnun kaldım, iklnci kez Gündoğdu beyin bu evinde kaldım, her iki konaklamam da çok iyiydi, beklentimi fazlasıyla karşıladı, teşekkürler.

description: Family apartments. Although this listing is new, there’s no need to worry 😊 I’m an experienced Superhost with 600+ positive reviews from my other apartments. Located in the heart of Sultanahmet, just a 5-minute walk to Hagia Sophia, the Blue Mosque, Topkapi Palace, the Basilica Cistern and Sultanahmet Square. The Bosphorus waterfront is just around the corner, with the Grand Bazaar, Spice Bazaar, tram, buses, metro and Eminönü ferries all within easy walking distance.

reviews.text:
First of all, the communication with Ali was great, which made me feel very comfortable even before our stay. Replies were prompt, kind and helpful. He arranged our taxis from and to the airport, was flexible with the check-in time and was helpful throughout our trip with tips and even gave us a brand new weighing machine from his grocery store to weigh our luggage before our departure.
The place was great in every sense. Not luxurious but clean and comfortable and the location is just a few minutes walk away from the Blue Mosque and Aya Sofia. The surrounding areas also have a lot to offer with plenty of shops, restaurants, the sea side and the grand Bazaar and it's wonderful to just go for walks at night. Also the tram station is easy to reach and visit other places in Istanbul.
The apartment itself is in a peaceful street and the inside is well represented by the pictures. It was great to have a large fridge, washing machine (9 days stay) and the AC worked great. Thank you Ali!

Ali ve eşi gerçekten harika ev sahipleri. İletişimleri çok hızlıydı, her konuda yardımcı oldular ve kendimizi çok rahat hissettik. Daire temiz, konforlu ve klima ile çamaşır makinesi gibi olanaklar büyük avantaj sağlıyor. Konumu çok iyi; güvenli bir bölgede ve İstanbul’un birçok önemli noktasına kolay ulaşım imkânı sunuyor. Fiyatına göre sunduğu kalite gerçekten çok iyi. İstanbul’da konaklayacak herkese gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederiz. Tekrar gelmeyi çok isteriz!

Very cozy apartment in the old town on a quiet street, in an old house - very authentic. Within walking distance of the Blue Mosque, St. Sophia Cathedral, there is a bazaar with souvenirs and sweets.
The landlord of the apartment is very hospitable: he helped arrange the transfer, met me on the street and helped me bring my things, showed me how to turn on everything. There were a pleasant compliment : very tasty peaches! The apartment has everything you need for a trip - washing machine, iron, hair dryer, toilet paper, soap, gel, shampoo, umbrellas, air conditioning, TV, Wi-Fi. I especially want to mention the huge bath towels :). The apartment is very atmospheric- stucco molding, embroidered pillows create a cozy atmosphere.
Nearby there is a food store, fruits and vegetables, dairy, household items (the store belongs to the same owner). The language of communication is English, the owner's wife speaks Russian.
We wholeheartedly recommend this apartment

The location was excellent and within walking distance of most of Istanbul’s major attractions. The owner, Ali, was incredibly friendly, helpful, and always available with great recommendations, making our stay even more enjoyable.
There was a police security post on the street 24/7, which made the area feel very safe.
Ali also owns a grocery shop nearby, which was very convenient for buying drinks and snacks, especially during the hot weather.
Overall, I had a wonderful stay at Ali’s Airbnb and have no complaints at all. I highly recommend it to anyone visiting Istanbul.

İstanbulda bir hafta konaklamak için bu daireyi tercih ettik .
Eve geldiğimizde hiç beklemeden gayet misafirperver bir şekilde karşılandık . Ev sahibimiz ihtiyaçlarımızı giderme noktasında her zaman oldukça hızlı ve yardımsever yaklaştı .
Ev konum olarak harika bir yerde, eşyalar biraz yıpranmıştı fakat temiz ve düzenliydi .Tekrar gelirsek kalmak isteyeceğimiz güzel bir tecrübeydi.Ev sahibimize bu süreçteki destekleri için teşekkür ederiz .

description: 360 Degree Historical peninsula terrace with Bosphorus view 1+1 suite,Bosphorus bridge, Maiden's tower, Topkapı palace, Hagia Sophia and Galata tower are overlooking. All of Istanbul is at your feet from all over the room. Galata tower is 150 meters away, 3 minutes away from transportation vehicles. History is within walking distance to all touristic places in the building. There is a terrace where you can use 50 square meters.

reviews.text: Worth the view. This unit is at the top floor. Comfortable. Instead of a kitchen there’s a mini fridge and electric kettle. Has an elevator but the last level you need to take the stairs. Great communication via the Airbnb app and easy check in.

Location! Wow! I started out in Türkiye with Kemal’s place and the address was clear when put in on maps, so no worries about finding it in a new city. The place was right next to the Galata tower and if you are fit, well I walked to all the great mosques -Hagia & Blue Mosque and also to Taksim square - from the apartment! There is a department store just down below, so no worries about daily needs!
View! Spectacular! I cannot stress enough on how beautiful & unique the view is from the room! I couldn’t get enough of waking up to this view! Please note that it has a shared balcony with the second apartment on the same floor with a beautiful planter as the divider :)
This room is spacious. The washroom has running hot water 24x7.
Finally, the host was perfect, responsive and very communicative! The check in was a breeze and Kemal was always available!
I loved the apartment so much that I booked the side apartment for my last leg of the trip too ;)
Thank you for hosting us!

The views from this Airbnb were absolutely stunning, even better than the pictures, which was a definite highlight of our stay. However, there were a few issues that detracted from the overall experience.
When we checked in, the room was very hot (around 90°F), and the AC was off. While the AC eventually cooled things down, there’s no ceiling fan, so the cool air didn’t always reach the bedroom, making it hard to keep up with the heat at times. Additionally, there was a noticeable smell of smoke inside on two of the three nights, which was unpleasant.
One important thing to note is that the balcony is shared with other units, something that wasn’t clear from the property description. Lastly, the bed was extremely firm — the hardest I’ve ever slept on, which may not be comfortable for everyone.
Overall, the apartment has potential, but a few adjustments could make it a much better stay.

Kemal’s place was fantastic when it comes to location and set up, in other words it looks exactly like the pictures, however, heads up, we went in May and the air conditioning was not working, it was unbearable, I recommend to go in the cooler months, never in the summer. Also the fridge never worked, the water we bought was warm because of that. We actually had to go out all day to cool off even though the temperatures outside were very hot. We only stay there at night to go to bed. The reception tried to help with the air conditioning to no avail. Other than that the place is wonderful, the view from the terraces leaves you breathless.

The accommodation is extremely uncomfortable and, in my opinion, does not live up to the price. There is mold in the shower, and the TV is old and doesn’t work. The air conditioning worked fine for the first two days, but on the third day, for some reason, it stopped cooling the room properly.
The only positives are the terrace and the nice view. Overall, the price-to-quality ratio does not meet expectations. Unfortunately, I cannot recommend staying here.

description:
Hello
Located in Zekeriyaköy, one of Istanbul's prestigious neighborhoods, this house features an independent entrance, a large living room, and a spacious bedroom. It's located on the garden floor
• A quiet, peaceful, secure, and safe environment surrounded by nature.
• A very large garden and terrace
• A double luxury bed and a double sofa bed
• Parking
• Close to the British School and Koç University
• Private pool
• Earthquake-resistant, sturdy construction
The perfect home and opportunity

reviews.text:
This was the best place we have stayed in Istanbul - out of 6 places - and definitely worth the price. The host family were very gracious and friendly.
Inside is decorated very tastefully and really worked for our one week stay. Outside, the place is in a beautiful, peaceful and private neighborhood.
You really want to have a car to drive around the mountains which are next to the water - very unique and picturesque.
The city is an upscale area of Istanbul that has everything we like and need. We definitely recommend the place and look forward to coming back.
Thank you, Behçet and your nice family for your hospitality.

I liked it very much. The house is very safe, quiet, close to the forest, in a mountainous area with clean air. The owner of the house is a friendly and helpful person. If you like to walk around, renting a car will greatly help you. It is easy to reach the Istanbul metro by public transport. Having a taxi office nearby is an added convenience.
Drinking tea and coffee at the table in the yard's simple but neat lawned garden in the late spring, warm summer and early autumn will give a person a particular pleasure.

It's hard to imagine that this quiet place is near Istanbul. The garden and swimming pool are well maintained, the view of the forest is magnificent and the neighborhood is extremely quiet (no dogs!). But you have to like being in a hermetically closed settlement with lots of security and far away from shopping facilities. Without a car you're lost here.
The apartment itself is in the basement of a detached house (the landlady's parents live upstairs) and offers enough privacy. For the price, however, I would have liked a bit more equipment, e.g. a writing desk instead of useless small furniture. Nevertheless, a great experience and I would gladly stay again.

Nice accommodation, very friendly and welcoming hosts, beautiful garden and direct access to pool of the compound. Everything was very clean. Compound is guarded.
By car you can reach many places in Istanbul easily and quickly without the usual huge Istanbul traffic.
The host family was very helpful, provided what we needed and also advised on several questions. Internet worked perfect and the apartment offered everything needed.
We will be happy to come again.
The house felt bigger than it looked in the photos. The host was welcoming and easy to communicate with. It’s surrounded by forest, which made it quiet and peaceful—nice place to relax.

description: You can find all utilities in the kitchen even dishwasher.Including tv.Bedroom has one more tv, safe box , very strong a.c .Bathroom is with washing machine.You can easily stay in the spacious apartment in the heart of Taksim .

reviews.text: We have stayed second time in Enver's Apartment. Thank you to Mr Enver for clean and cozy place to live in Istanbul. The owner is very friendly and helpful. It was comfortable to reside in the apartment with big beds, fully equipped kitchen and great bathroom. The apartment has all different things for easy life in Istanbul. Absolutely recommend this apartment for all, who want to stay near Taxim square in Istanbul.

ENVER IS AWESOME!
Great stay and close to everything.
Walking distance to everything and more that you need.
Clean, all amenities you need for a short or long stay. Very secure and safe. Wish there was better wifi downstairs though in the evenings.
Enver is an amazing host and provided tons of great information for us 🙌 He was great to chat with.
Highly recommend staying here.

One of the best places to stay in the City Center of Istanbul. It was very comfortable to live a week in the apartment during COVID pandemic. Mr Enver met us at necessary time and described all main things, that we should know. There were good functioning washing machine, dish washer, microwave oven, refrigerator, all that can help you to live without problem in Istanbul during a long period of time. Especially we appreciated for heating system, that help us during cold rainy days. In general, apartment has all, that you need to stay in Istanbul during your business trip or holiday.

I want to thank Enver for every single thing . Was great to be in Istanbul in his place, I felt at home and I felt I had a friend in town! He helped me in any occasion and so promptly that I couldn't have hoped for anything better.
The place is in a perfect position just two minutes walk from Taksim Square, from the tube and from the funicular.
The house was clean and with all the essentials I needed, the bedroom so silent and the bed so comfortable that I had good and relaxing sleeps!
Great experience!

Mr Enver is a great host who will always make your stay comfortable. He is responsive and available. The apartment was excellent. Location is great and close to public transportation. 100% recommendable.

description:
Our home is very cozy. We have a private room for guests. There is a single bed, a drawer, a closet, a table, a mirror and an air conditioner in the room. There are 2 bathrooms in the home. Guests have private bathroom. We have free wifi.

Please note that we have ONE PRIVATE ROOM WITH SINGLE BED.

reviews.text: The room and house is every clean and comfortable. Hostess came to the metro station and picked me up, which saved me lots of trouble. Host and hostess offered great assistance during my stay. They are so nice, i feel as being with family. The town of the house location is near to seaside, which also worth to spend some time to walk around.

Its a home away from home. I really felt in this house like a part of the family! It's amazing place with so warm and welcoming hosts. Azize and her husband are one of the most kind, attentive and friendly hosts I have ever met! the room I was staying was really cozy, clean, comfortable and warm. I enjoyed staying in this place so much and I didn't want to leave.
Would say couple words about the location and area. Its really near the airport, also easy get to the metro, bus station, shopping area and amazing walkway next to the sea. Plenty of cafes, restaurants and bars.
It is one of the warmest places I was staying and I really recommend it for everyone!

Azize and her Husband are great hosts. Even upon arriving they made sure that everything was organized well. She provided me great directions on how to get to their apartment. I had a great welcoming. The apartment is located very central and has easy access to public transportation. It is by an sports area where you can play tennis and do other outdoor activites. The ocean is near by, 10 minutes walking distance. I was invited to join the family dinner, lunch and breakfast all the time. Azize is an amazing cook. She prepares hyper delicious food and cakes. The room is exactly as in the pictures, very comfortable and practial in use. The interior design is also outstanding. Overall I had a great stay and can absolutely recommend Azizes home to stay short or long-term.

Azize’s place is located in Yeşilköy. A quick 10 minute walk brings you to the train station which you can take to get into the touristy parts of Istanbul. Azize’s listing was clean, comfortable, and spacious enough for two guests. My brother and I stayed with her and her husband for a week and we felt so welcome and were always asked to join them for some yummy breakfast. Thank you for everything, Azize!

Azize is the best AirBnB host I’ve ever had. She came to pick me up early in the morning at the airport and offered breakfast as soon we got to the house. Her house is splendid and clean. It is very comfortable and private. For 4days I stayed in her place, I went back and forth to Istanbul and the airport and it was just the perfect locations for all the travels. (There is convenient bus direct line to the heart of Istanbul)
Her welcoming vibe and kindness will really warm your heart. Her knowledge and willingness to connect with you in a human level will make you fall in love with Turkish people. I will really miss Azize and her husband’s beautiful smiles over breakfast!

description: Private flat with balcony and king size bed. The flat is cozy clean with all amenities located in Beyoğlu(the heart of İstanbul) in Cihanir nearly Karaköy İstiklal and Çukurcuma. The location is easy to find and in safest part of the city.

reviews.text: The place has very great location and the appartement is very spacious and has amazing view (6th floor no elevator, no problem for me just for you to know). Betul was very easy to communicate to and very nice. Her cat Sancho is so cute. There is no separation of the bedroom to the kitchen though so he would come during the night.

Betül’s place is in a great location very near to other neighborhoods like Karaköy and Beyoğlu. The neighborhood itself is very nice, there are nice cafes in the area.
The apartment is on the top floor and there is no elevator, but the view from the top is with it. The apartment is nice, clean and quite large.
Betul is really hospitable and kind person, house was as it is described ,clean and close to everywhere

betul is a great host, she is very accomodating and made extra effort to make our stay more memorable and fun.. well recommended 😊.. missing kitty (owner's cat) as we got used to him sleeping beside us. the stairs going up the 6th floor is exhausting but the view from the flat is worth it.
my best Airbnb experience so far. thanks betül for her great hospitality. great location in heart of city and a great view from the 6th floor. clean and well-organized apartment.

description:
Studio apartment is created by an experienced design office with minimalist-style. Renovated and refurbished historic building is located in one of the oldest centers of Istanbul which offers the guests a spectacular view and location.
*** "There's a wooden spiral staircase to reach this apartment which is on the second floor." ***

reviews.text:
I didn’t expect this to be part of a boutique hotel. When you first arrive, they ask for ID’s and hand you the keys from a reception desk.
I chose Airbnb when I travel because I enjoy living like a local. This wasn’t the experience that I expected.
They freshly painted the place and it had a strong smell. The stairs rail wasn’t safe or well-mounted. I couldn’t find parking in the area. The noise from people walking up the stairs didn’t stop all night. It was pretty loud. I really couldn’t sleep at all.
The host was responsive. But the place was not a good value for the money.

Great value and close to Galata Tower! It was 2-3 min walking Galata Tower and ~15 min to Karakoy. Close to the metro Shishane as well. It made it easy to get around. The room itself is really pretty, comfy beds, AC (hot in the summer!) and a big shower. Our preference is to have some space for our luggage, but our travel style means we spend most of the time outside the room. The staff was super friendly + responsive. They fixed the shower immediately after we asked (wasn't draining). Sometimes you can hear people walking up and down the hallway, but even my husband, who is a light sleeper, slept well. They even give you a little guide + map with some good + design-forward restaurants in the area, which we shared with some other travelers. Really liked it here + would stay again if in Istanbul (:

We were supposed to stay here for 2 nights and I have to be honest and not recomend this place for this time. We cancelled the reservation immediatly upon arrival - But the owner was extremely helpfull and gave us all the money back. The room did not match the photos, the bedding and room in general was very dirty. The Walls and roof was falling apart and the AC was making a terrible loud sound.
Great place to stay! Clean, comfortable, and in a perfect location. The staff were kind and helpful. Highly recommended!
Super comfortable and clean, great location and helpful stuff!

description: My house is located in the center of a historic neighborhood. This historical, private, two-floored house has a balcony with a view of sea of Marmara and it takes 3 mins walk to there and 10 mins to Tramway station. Hagia Sophia, Sultanahmet Mosque & Hippodrome, Topkapi Palace, Basilica Cistern, Little Hagia Sophia, Mosaic Museum, Carpet museum, Arasta Bazaar and many other historical sites are all in the walking distance. It is surrounded by lots of cafes, restaurants and shops.

reviews.text:
Wahid was an amazing host, he offered us tea when we first arrived, gave us lots of local recommendations and answered all of our questions. He was extremely friendly and even let us keep our luggage with him after checkout given our late departure. He was very responsive and helpful throughout the entire stay!
The apartment is exactly what you see in the pictures, perfect for 3 people, great location close to all the historical sites and lots of restaurants in the area. The cafe right across the street was convenient and delicious! The apartment is a bit loud at night but we all had ear plugs which made it bearable. Air conditioning in the larger bedroom and upstairs in the kitchen/sofa bed area which worked perfectly. The base of the bathroom shower could use replacing but other than that it was a great stay!

Our stay lasted 4 days during which we had all that we needed. Very clean place, comfortable bed with all necessary amenities such as towels and sheets provided. AC and fan worked.
Wahid is very easy to talk to and super helpful. He invited us to drink tea with him in his shop below the house. As we love the traditional patterns we also bought two cushion covers at a very reasonable price.
We had our five-month old daughter with us and the cot Wahid provided was also clean and comfortable. She slept through the night easily.
Neighborhood is very nice and welcoming; very helpful and genuinely love children.
An unforgettable experience in beautiful Istanbul.

We choose Wahid’s place because of the location, description and accurate pictures. It was a good choice. If you have an issue climbing stairs you need to might not want to stay here, as there are some to climb to get to the bedrooms and kitchen/eating areas. We totally enjoyed our stay, with many restaurants and sights to see within a 10 minute walk. Wahid is a very good host and is always available for help, tea and a good chat. We would definitely stay here again.

The apartment was everything as advertised. Clean, Simple, and adequate. Note the shower had particularly good pressure. All basic kitchen utensils and dishes were provided. The full-sized fridge is nice to store cold drinks and fruits. The terrace was a bonus if you like to sit outside and watch everyday local life pass by.
Wahid is a kind and accommodating host. I would agree and echo all the other comments regarding this.
Location is probably the most outstanding aspect. It is about 5min walk to the Blue Mosque. 10min from nearest tram station. 15min walk to Grand Bazaar. 20-30min walk to Galata bridge. Along the way are countless cafes, restaurants, small markets, and anything you can think of. Basically its in a near-perfect location for the Sultanahmet (historic old-city) area
One thing to keep in mind is the close proximity to a few mosques and their 5x per day prayers are cast on loudspeaker. I did not have any problem, but light sleepers should take note. Also, the whole Sultanahmet is cobblestoned and hilly, so be prepared to do a lot of uphill-downhill walking.

Highly recommended.
Apartment was very clean. Its surrounded by restaurants, grocery stores, laundry shops and tour operators. Great location, competitively priced. Walking distance from Blue Mosque and tram system.
Our 6 day stay was very comfortable. Honest, family oriented and super helpful host. He knows the area well and provides useful directions. Always keen to ensure that the guests have best possible experience.

description: The Blue House Taksim is located in the heart of Istanbul, just a 3-minute walk to Taksim Square, İstiklal Street, and the metro. This private triplex house with 3 bedrooms offers everything you need for a comfortable stay, including high-speed Wi-Fi, AC, Smart TV, dishwasher, and all essentials. Enjoy easy access to shopping, restaurants, and public transport while staying in the center of the city. The entire house is yours—relax and enjoy your stay!

reviews.text:
We recently stayed in this apartment in Istanbul and overall had a pleasant experience, with both positives and a few important things future guests should know.
The apartment is located in a more peripheral area of the city. There is a metro station about 5–10 minutes away on foot, which is convenient, although getting to the city center still takes around 40–45 minutes to 1h, especially when traveling with a toddler. It is relatively close to Taksim Square, and the area itself is quieter than expected.
I would not recommend the apartment for families with small children. It is split across three floors connected by steep stairs that are not clearly shown in the photos, and the railings are not secure.
There are also some maintenance issues: a leaking toilet, a broken/unusable showerhead, and a lingering cigarette smell, including in the bedrooms.
On the positive side, the beds were very comfortable and the kitchen was well equipped.

Berk's triplex house is just minutes away from Taksim Square, the funicular tram station, the Taksim tunnel (if you want to use the bus) and Point Hotel for airport bus to/from Sabiha or Istanbul airport. It is also very near to Taksim Camii and Istiklal St.
Berk is very welcoming and responsive towards my queries and I asked a lot of questions :) And the instruction to enter the house is clear and easy to follow as well.
The house is very warm and cosy. We cooked dinner and breakfast nearly everyday during our stay. The Ground Floor has a half toilet and a bedroom - 2 single beds. The 1st floor are for the kitchen, bathroom and the living room. The 2nd floor has two bedrooms with queen beds. All the rooms are just like what was shown in the pictures. The stairs is spiral and quite steep. If you have young children, just ensure they don't play near the stairs and it should be all right.
Overall, our stay of 6 days & 5 nights (5 adults) have been lovely, pleasant and enjoyable.

Berk's place was super clean. The location is great, close to restaurants, shops, and coffee places. Berk was very responsive, polite, and helpful. The check in and check out went very smooth. The place exactly matches the pictures. The first floor includes a small bathroom without shower and a room with two double beds. The second floor includes the kitchen and living room. The third floor includes two bedrooms with a queen bed each. We were a family of 7, and we felt comfortable there. I am very satisfied with my reservation.

Generally the Airbnb was okay.
Communication with Berk via phone and messenger was simple and fast. Berk solved an issue pretty promptly. The transfer was very easy to book. The taxi came right to the Airbnb despite narrow streets and on time.
Location is very nice in Taksim but many hills and not disabled friendly.
Biggest problem of the house are the very steep stairs between the floors which were not on the photos. Therefore we can‘t recommend the Airbnb to people with kids or people with disabilities. Additionally the state of the house is not up to the photos. In the bathroom is mold (a lot) and rotten doorframes due to water dripping out the shower. This could be an easy fix but is not getting taken care of. The amount of toilet paper, soap, dishwasher tabs, cutlery etc. was very limited and not matching the amount of guests.
We really hope the mentioned problems will be fixed in future because otherwise the apartment is quite nice for a big company

If you are looking to visit Istanbul Berk place is the best place to stay in !!
I visited Istanbul 4 times in the past, stayed in 5 stars hotels and now there is no doubt, that choosing Berk apartment was the best decision.
As a super host on Airbnb I could tell that that Berk apartment is in a very high standard! and berk is more then excellent host. I was staying with another 2 friends of mine and the also agreed that the apartment is just super great, in a 5 stars standard !
The apartment is full equipped, first floor you have 1 bed room and a bathroom.
second floor you have living room, kitchen and bathroom with shower.
Third floor 2 master bed room.
The beds are very comfortable, there is a lot space in every room, and privacy.
During my Stay (December) the house was warm 24 hours there is a central heating. Also you have AC in every room.
The house was super clean and that eased very important for me!
The house is 3 min by walk to Taksim Square there you have basically one of the main famous street in Istanbul.
To the grand baZar it was 20 min waking.
There are a lot to do and to see around the apartment, a lot of coffee shops, bars 7 min walking, the location is just perfect!
Berk is really super host very welcoming ! Answered all my questions respond very fast, great recommendation, he is a truly great host.
Long story short if these apartment is available book it, don’t think twice and you will not regret.
I will definitely will visit the apartment again for my next visit to Istanbul and will
Recommend it to all of my friends.

description:
Our spacious three bedroom serviced apartments are the perfect fit for families, group of friends or business associates who are looking for longer stays.

The apartments are cleaned daily by housekeeping, and all bedding and towels are changed once every three days.

The setup comes with three bedrooms (two double beds, two single beds), two bathrooms, closed kitchen, living room, and a balcony.

Located on floors 1 through 6.

Brought to you by PRINCESS RESIDENCE.

reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
We had an absolutely wonderful stay! The apartment was clean, comfortable, beautifully maintained, and exactly as described. The location was very convenient, and everything we needed was close by.
The management team especially Mr. Ahmet was incredibly kind, responsive, and helpful throughout our stay. We truly appreciated the hospitality and attention to detail.
We really enjoyed our time here and would definitely stay again. Highly recommended! 😎

We loved our stay here, the workers were so welcoming helpful and kind. The building is very clean modern, has an elevator. It has all the comforts of a hotel with a lobby but the staff are so friendly and the has all the comforts of home. We will always stay here when visiting Istanbul.

Very clean and comfortable accommodation. The service was excellent. Mr Orhan was particularly helpful with our booking and attentive to all our needs. The staff were very friendly. We were greeted with smiles every day. I would highly recommend Princess Residence to other travelers. Thank you to Mr Orhan and all the staff for a pleasant stay. We hope to stay here again in the future.

Amazing! Amazing! Amazing! Super clean, super fresh, super new apartment! The most professional administrator ever I met in Istanbul, with the perfect English and readiness to help in any time of the day and night. We got welcomed with the warm heart and snacks in the apartment. Even slippers were there :) Next time we stay on Asian Side- only that hotel! Just a quick note, the hotel is situated closer to Sabiha Gokcen airport, it is far from the city center and great for a business trips, or family economic stays. I highly recommend this place for everyone!

Daire olanakları çok iyiydi. Sorunlarımıza kısa sürede çözüm buldular. İşletme konusunda hiç sıkıntı yaşamadık. Sadece havlular daha temiz olabilirdi. Tek sıkıntı konum. Çok merkezi bir yer değil. Ev sahibine konaklamamız süresince desteği ve anlayışı için çok teşekkür ederiz.

description:
Enjoy a comfortable stay in the heart of the city in our modern and centrally located apartment
2 bedrooms
Living room and equipped kitchen
TV
Washer
Dishwasher
Refrigerator
indoor parking(Paid)
Cleaning service
7/24 reception
5 adults or
4 adults and 2 children (10 years old)
Location:
Central location in Beşiktaş Gayrettepe
Easy access to markets, restaurants, and shopping malls
Close to public transportation

When I’m in Istanbul again, I’d definitely have another stay at the place, it is close to most important locations in Istanbul and the place is quite spacious apart being luxurious. Fully recommend staying at least one night there.

This second floor three bedroom apartment offers generous living areas with modern comfort and practical details, creating a relaxed and enjoyable stay in one of the city’s most vibrant neighborhoods. reviews.text:
The place is bigger then expected. It has high ceiling everywhere. Even in the toilets and showers. Plenty of cupboards, drawers and storage spaces for luggage etc. All three toilets and two bathrooms are clean well designed and have powerful showers. Ac is great and works perfectly. Plenty of extras available like towel, beddings, pillows, toilet paper, drinking water, washing machine powder and a great dishwasher with pills.
The kitchen comes with everything you can think you need. Eg, they had four different coffee makers (not electric). An amazing pro gym downstairs with sauna. Two or three Remote controlled sky-windows. Which are electrically operated which is a lovely touch. Security very professional and helpful. When I came back late at night the security would always open the door for me via buzzer.m before i manged to put the simple code for entry which shows a personal service only dreamed of in a good hotel. It also shows the security is always looking at the cctv as he is in a different building. The place is surprisingly very quite but withing 1min walk to the Galata Tower. You will only know how special this is if you've been to that part of Istanbul and saw how hustle and bustle and busy it is. If you go to the top of the street on your right there is a great coffee shop with lovely sandwiches and croissant freshly made. Almost opposite of the coffee shop is a great little place for fresh juice and nice place for food 10 meters to the left of the coffee shop. It exceeded all my expectations.

Great location. Galata tower, mini supermarkets and restaurants were close by. A short walk to the T1 tram line.
The flat was great for 4 people - they had created a 3rd bedroom after we had booked, but we didn't need it. 2 good size bedrooms with plenty of wardrobe space and each had an en-suite shower room. The 3rd bedroom was served by a separate shower room. The flat was airy, light and clean. It was on the 2nd floor and there is no lift. This was our second stay here, and we came back not only because of the excellent location near Galata Tower, but also because of the outstanding hospitality. A very spacious and comfortable apartment. It was very clean and well looked after. The location is excellent, with plenty to do in the area and also convenient for transport. The host was extemely responsive and professional. 100% recommended!

Perfect location, spacious apartment - nice and clean, everything as described and expected.
We traveled with our two small kids and grandparents, and all worked fantastic. We are very happy with our stay, and would return again.

description:
Dear guests,
We are Turkish/German couple living mainly in Berlin but we love spending time in fascinating Istanbul. We have a historical flat which is located in the heart of the oldest and most charming part of Istanbul Çukurcuma - Cihangir is well known for its many antiques & curio shops, hidden gems of all kinds. Be aware that you will be experiencing and enjoying Istanbul here at its best especially if you are a lover of history, culture, art, good food, etc.

reviews.text:
I highly recommend Elif's flat if you are visiting Istanbul, from a few nights to a medium to long-term stay. The images are a perfect representation of the flat - only it is more beautiful, more relaxing, and more than one could possibly expect until walking through the beautiful original wooden front doors. The flat is well-equipped and it is very clean and feels so well cared for. The kitchen is a dream, especially the beautiful professional-style oven that is any cook's dream.
Even though my stay was during Istanbul's winter, it was warm enough most days to have the balcony doors open, especially when cooking. I could hear in the distance the sound of air horns from ships on the Bosphorus, and the chatter on the streets below, reminding me of the vibrant and lovely city that is Istanbul. At the same time, the flat is quiet and peaceful when the doors and windows are closed - I slept soundly every night!
One of the three stools that sit with the kitchen island is also the perfect place to hang out for hours, drinking coffee or tea and reading, working on your laptop, or sipping an evening glass of wine while cooking. The view from the loft - as well as the balcony - is quite special, especially at sunrise, sunset, and after dark. Their is great space to stow luggage out of the way. The washing and drying machines are an absolute wonderful treat for a longer stay. The bed is so comfortable and the bathroom and shower rivals a 5-star hotel. Elif is responsive and so kind, and the check in process was seamless and clever. There is no elevator and the flat is up two flights, so if you have heavy luggage get some help from your taxi and tip him well!
Think of it as a daily workout to relax your legs after climbing up and down the hills of Istanbul! The neighbors are so lovely. The neighborhood is one of my favorites and there is so much to do right outside the front door, even during the current COVID lockdown. I stay in many AirBnB when I travel and I have to say, Elif's place was among the best. It's quite a special place in a very special city in one of the most beautiful countries in the world.
Thank you, Elif, for the beautiful space and place and for being a wonderful host! teşekkür ederim!

This was definitely one of the best Airbnb experiences we've ever had, probably the best. First of all, communication with Elif was very efficient – she always replied quickly and gave very easy-to-follow instructions on the check in and other questions. Secondly, this apartment has what I think is the best location there could be in Istanbul if you want to experience the city to it's fullest. You can easily walk or get by public transport quickly enough to all of the sights in the European side, the ferries to Asian side and the Islands are also in walking distance, but also you get the prettiest streets with art galleries, designer stores, vintage and a great assortment of restaurants and bars (many serve take-away and in good weather you can enjoy the food at nearby steps with great Bosphorus views!) as well as a lot of very good (3d wave) coffee places – and all this in the 10 min walking distance from the apartment!
As for the apartment itself: it is a unique place – not a generic airbnb experience. You have to walk up to the second floor (there is no lift), but there are so many steps waiting for you on the hills of Istanbul that these two flights you won't even notice. Inside, you get very high ceilings, huge and very cozy master bedroom with a hammok-type chair, a room-turned-huge-walk-in-closet, great designer bathroom with very nice water pressure, and a spacious kitchen-living room with a mezzanine. Upstairs (on the mezzanine) there is a sofa (it could be turned into a bed, but not a very comfortable one, there are fine extra mattresses for sleeping there though), and a second bathroom with a washer and a dryer (keep in mind that this bathroom doesn't have a fully closing door, just a curtain). The kitchen deserves another mention: there is a huge gas stove, and it's really equipped for any type of cooking - there are a lot of pots&pens&plates etc., a large fridge, a dishwasher. Also it's very conveniently and beautifully designed – you would even enjoy that there are reasons to cook during lockdown (buy supplies at a great Carrefour gourmet 5 min from the house). Finally, the balcony. It was the greatest surprise for us: it's not just spacious and has comfortable furniture, but it faces sunset and has an amazing view over the city towards Galata tower and the mosques of Sultanahmet. Just the view from the balcony is reason enough to stay here!
All in all – we do recommend this place if you wish to have a really great Istanbul experience.

Elif's apartment is very clean, comfortable and convenient. I highly recommend it to stay.
location - it felt safe any time of the day. it's located in the neighborhood with lots of
restaurants, bars and cafes so it was super convenient. the old city is practically walking distance (15 mins walk). but the tram (2 stops to the spice bazaar) is also only 5 mins away (all downhill from the apartment so it was easy too). it's also relatively close to Taksim sq so it was convenient for shopping as well.
amenities - the kitchen is nice and pretty much fully equipped. i wanted to try out as much of local food as possible so i didn't cook but if i were to cook, the kitchen was ready for it. the apartment is also clean and comfortable and spacious. it also has a nice bathroom with a super nice shower on downstairs. If i had to nitpick something, it could be noisy on Fri and/or Sat night with some street noise but it wasn't so bad.

(seriously)

My wife and I found the apartment very comfortable and the amenities were very accessible and useful. The level of the kitchen was an impressive. Elif was always pleasant and very responsive when I had any questions. I whole-heartedly recommend this property for anyone looking for a locale in a bustling neighborhood in Istanbul.

Everything has been considered for the comfort of our guests in our perfectly decorated house.

reviews.text: A bit noisy as restaurants outside the apartment but at least not thumping loud. Earplugs provided were appreciated and great help for sleeping. Linens clean and most surface areas clean. Only area of built up mould in the shower recess along the floor edge on the door. A good dousing of cleaner got rid of it. This was the only unclean area. There was all the things we needed for using the kitchen plus tea coffee detergents washing powder scrubs and cleaning equipment plus soaps. Bed comfortable though on the firm side. Yasmin very responsive as we had trouble using the lock. It required a bit of a pull back as the key is turned to open. We had to twice get assistance getting it to work. Just needs replacing. All up though for the price in Kadikoy not a bad place.

I had a great stay at Yasemin’s Airbnb. She was extremely helpful and friendly throughout the visit, making everything easy and welcoming. The home was exactly as shown in the pictures—clean, well-kept, and comfortable. It was spotless when I arrived. On top of that, the location was perfect, with plenty to do and explore right outside the door. I’d definitely stay here again!

Öncelikle eve girdiğimiz anda yüzümüze resmen temizlik kokusu çarptı🌸 Ev konum olarak Kadıköy’ün en merkezi konumunda. Çevresinde misafirlerin ihtiyacı olabilecek her şey mevcut. Marketlere, kafelere çok yakın; metroya, otobüs duraklarına 5-10 dakikalık yürüme mesafesinde. Evin dizaynı, konforu ve içindeki ihtiyaç malzemeleri de eksiksiz. Neye ihtiyacımız olduysa rahatlıkla erişebildik. Diş fırçası ve macunu, şampuan, lif vs. getirmeyi unutmuştuk mesela fakat ev sahibimiz bizim için önceden düşünüp koymuştu bunları☺️ Bir ara ufak bir karın ağrısı yaşayınca su torbası alalım dedik, o bile vardı evde🤣 Yasemin’in iletişimine ve misafirperverliğine değinmiyorum bile. Ne zaman ulaşmak istesem ulaşabildim, giriş ve çıkışta çok yardımcı oldu, eve ilk girdiğimizde yemek söyleyene kadar aç kalmayalım diye ikramlık yiyecekler bırakmıştı bir de🥰 Her şey için teşekkür ederim kendisine, yeniden yolumuz düşerse tercih edeceğimiz ilk yer onun evi olur, siz de gönül rahatlığıyla tercih edebilirsiniz👍🏻

I stayed in Yasemin's place for two weeks and it just felt like home. The neighborhood is beautiful and picturesque. Walking into the apartment you will notice how much attention and love this place has received. There are so many little beautiful details about the interior design of this place that make this place very unique and worth your while. Yasemin is also very proactive and checked with me multiple times in order to make sure everything is all right. I highly recommend this place if you are looking for a long stay. There is some noise from the cafes and bars on the street but that's part of the deal and it is already mentioned in the listing so I was expecting that. Thank you so much for being such a great host

Daha önce Yasemin Hanımın başka bir dairesinde konaklamıştık ve çok memnun kalmıştık. Çok yardımsever bir ev sahibi. Dairesi fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibi. Çok temiz ve kullanışlı bir daire. İhtiyacımız olan her şey mevcuttu. Dairenin konumu çok merkezi. Etrafında birçok kafe, restoran, bar ve market var. Metro, metrobüs ve iskelelere yürüme mesafesinde. Yalnız biraz gürültülü bir muhit. Biz sesten rahatsız olmadık ama sese karşı hassasiyeti olanlar için erken saatte uyumak zor olabilir.

description: A first-floor apartment in Sami Bey Apartmanı, built in the 1950s by my grandfather Dr. Zülfü Sami Özgen. Fully refurbished — new kitchen and bathrooms, heating and air conditioning — with white brick, kilims and a glass-block wall running the length of the hall. 70 m², with the Bosphorus and Dolmabahçe Mosque through the living room doors. Three bedrooms sleeping five; a hydro-massage shower in one of the two bathrooms. First floor — 31 steps, the shortest climb in the building.

reviews.text:
Thanks Emirhan for sharing your lovely place with us and Tuna for helping with the check in that was convenient.
The apartment is strategically located @ Kabatas Begylou. Apartment is neat, clean and spacious as described in the pictures.. the view is totally breathtaking of the Bhosphorus. It’s just across the Dolmabache Mosque & Palace. 200m to the Funicular (to Taksim Square saves you the walk uphill), metro and the ferries to the Asian side. The amnesties were sufficient and as it’s winter there’s heating. Cooking facilities are available though there’s lots of options on food around especially around Taksim.
We will definitely stay in this place whenever we return to Istanbul. Lovely place only downside apartment is on the first floor a bit of a climb as no lifts to the first floor. Nonetheless a lovely place with a beautiful view..

Mr. Emirhan & Mrs. Tuna are great hosts, they are very welcoming & helpful.
Moreover Mrs. Tuna is always helpful, She provided us with the information we needed and showed us around, everytime we contact her she always replied or called rightaway and answered all our questions nicely.
When we had a problem with 1 of the bathroom - the shower’s drain is clogged, she sent the doorman to look at it and he got it fixed quickly, which was great👍🏼👍🏼
The apartment is perfect!
Very instagramable, all furnitures are well-kept, the place looks exactly like it does on the pictures. The neighborhood is very conveniently located, we got amazing view from the balcony which we really love!💗💗
The kitchen is compact and contains everything we need. The home appliances such as washing machine, toaster, stove etc are working well.
They provided us with cooking oil, sugar, salt, pepper, coffee, tea, paper towels, garbage bag, toilet paper etc quite generously.
The bedrooms are nice & tidy with extra pillows and blankets on the side, if we need more. The beds & pillows are kind of on the hard side to our preference. The bathrooms are clean, all the towels are clean, fluffy & quite thick which we like.
The apartment is walking distance to some tourist attractions and close by to public transportations such as trams & buses.
All in all we felt very happy staying here and totally recommend this wonderful apartment!

I had a great experience staying here, the host Tuna was very helpful and responsive to my queries and helped me throughout my stay.
The place looked exactly like the photos, with stunning views of the Bosphorus and the Dolmabahce mosque. It was clean, spacious and the AC worked perfectly.
The location is a a walking distance to the Kabatas tram station, so you can explore around the city easily.
They provided very great WiFi, and TV with many channels. Hot water working very well and I am loving the interior design. They have a brand new fridge as well.
Thankyou Mr. Emirhan and Mrs. Tuna for this wonderful experience at your place, looking forward to visiting again!

I recently stayed at this apartment near Kabatas, Istanbul, and found it to be an excellent location for easy transportation access, as it's close to buses, taxis, and ferries. The proximity to different parts of the city, including Besiktas and Taksim (just a 20-minute walk), made exploring Istanbul a breeze.
The house was clean, although there is some room for improvement. One shower was small and occasionally had a sewer smell, particularly in the smaller bathroom. If you plan to work remotely, be aware that the street noise can be a bit loud, but closing the windows does help to minimize the disturbance.
One issue we faced was the weak Wi-Fi signal in the two back rooms. If you need high-speed internet, you'll need to use it in the main hall. Despite these minor drawbacks, I would definitely recommend this place, thanks to its prime location and the wonderful host, Tuna, who was extremely welcoming and helpful. She provided us with useful information and made our stay enjoyable

We enjoyed the apartment very much. lt has an amazing view and a great location with quiet bedrooms, nice kitchen and other essential tools, and more importantly a very responsive host. In rush hours, there can be a big traffic and crowd outside, but even that doesn’t disturb the peace that you experience inside.
The pictures completely match the reality. There are only a few more stairs, but no issue at all.
l would definitely recommend it.

description: We are Tsn for Property Mngmt company with over 45 apts in our portfolio. Our 1 Br apt is located in Hacımimi street, Galata. Located in third floor, 500 meters away from Galata Tower w/ easy access to all attractions and hip restaurants & cafes in its neighbourhood. The apt is 45 sqm and well designed for our guests needs: 1 bedroom, a bathroom, a kitchen with all appliances and utilities, a large living room, ULTRA FAST wifi. We look forward to hosting you here

reviews.text:
We had a pleasant stay in this apartment. It is very well located (close to everything), bright, quiet, and very clean. The living room is comfortable, the kitchen is fully equipped and functional, and the bedroom has enough space to store clothes. The air conditioning in both the bedroom and the living room was a real plus. We also enjoyed the small sunny balcony with a table, and the rooftop terrace of the building. Communication with the hosts was perfect – they were very helpful and responsive.
There are, however, a few aspects to be aware of: there is a noisy device at the entrance, the bathroom is quite small, and the bed was not very comfortable as the mattress is a bit uneven. The apartment is on the top of a slope and located on the 3rd floor without an elevator, which may be difficult for some. We also noticed an unpleasant smell and some mold above the shower, likely related to drainage issues.
Overall, it’s a nice apartment with great hosts.

The host was very responsive and the place was good value for money. However, the place looks a little cleaner/more put together in the photos than it was in reality. The flat is basic- and that might be a perfect choice if you are looking for somwhere to simply sleep and keep your suitcase. The mattress was bowed and uncomfortable, the pillows could use some upgrading as well- all the fluff had separated. The towels had stains. The living room could be benefitted by lamps so that you could use the space for reading and relaxing without bright overhead lights. The shower head needs replacing. The yellow chair in the photos is pretty stained. It's possible to hear the other flats at night/in the morning, so bear that in mind if you are a light sleeper.
Overall the communication for check in went well, though we arrived at 2am. We also once locked our keys in the flat and they were super quick to come around and let us in.

We had mixed reviews staying here. Whilst we really enjoyed the location we unfortunately did not have a pleasant day at the Airbnb. The host was quite responsive over messages and kindly allowed us a late checkout till 12 pm.
During our stay which spanned over four days, the smell in the bathroom was very foul. This got progressively worse. We did not feel comfortable using the bathroom nor shower facilities; the smell was too foul. We communicated this with the host who explained us that the rainfall had caused sewage problems. For this reason alone, I would not stay again.
Another thing to note is that, the stairs are very narrow and steep. It’s quite unsafe if you are carrying heavy luggages as the Airbnb is on the third/ fourth floor. We struggled with this.
The front door also locks quite poorly, it will take a while to open as you need to toggle with the keys.
Other than this, there was nothing bad to say about the hosts. Thank you for letting us stay at your place.

Great location and clean apartment - host was very responsive and offered to fix the leaking AC very quickly. Enjoyed the stay very much in the heart of Istanbul. Note that it is on the 4th floor with windy stairs - however worth the walk up.

The location is amazing! 5mins from tram, 5min from metro, just a little bit of climbing up the hills. Super close to restaurants, the galata tower and cosy streets. Good communication, clear instructions. However the appartment itself is not great and quite worn out. We did not sleep well: the matrass is way too hard and had a bump in the center (even though it was supposed to be replaced) and the AC in bedroom can't be adjusted other than temp. Awful noise and too much wind, we couldn't sleep with it on. The one in the living has a machine in the hallway that also makes a lot of noise now and then, so couldn't sleep with that one on either. Rooftop terrace is worn out and just creates noise moving chairs above you. Since you can't drink the water (which we didn't know) some bottles of water WOULD have been appreciated. Musty staircase (and 4th floor is a long climb after going up the street!) and very limited hot water in the shower. Kitchen ammendities good for cooking.

description:
Your cozy home is located in Istanbul, Taksim area @Beyoglu. It's about 200 meter away from the British Consulate and the world famous Istiklal Street which is no doubt the most colorful place with cafes, bars, shopping, art galleries, nightlife etc.
There is no extra cleaning after checkin, but we can consider cleaning when you request.

reviews.text:
The apartment is very spacious. The pictures give a good idea of the rooms.
The beds are comfortable, note that as it is mentioned in the description it's 2 single beds put together.
We had a bit of an issue with the check-in, the apartment being ready only 2h after the 1PM advertized check-in time but that could be an one-off event.
The shower pressure is great and water is hot. AC/heating works very well.
Sounds isolation in the apartment is good.
Location of the apartment is great, a few minutes walk from Taksim with plenty of restaurants and shops.
Verda is a nice host, helpful and her husband is very nice and kind.

Verda's suit was really comforting. I stayed there with my family for almost a week and it was perfect from every aspect. Verda and her husband were so kind and helpful. The house was so clean and there was a complete set of furniture in the kitchen, living room, bathroom, and bedroom that we could enjoy. Also, the location is close to the Taksim square where you can find every kind of shops, stores, taxi's and you can have a quick access to the Isteqlal avenue which is the main street in the city center.

Verda and her husband are very helpful and friendly hosts, helped us with heating and internet troubles, and even allowed us to check out late
It's a cozy and warm apartment, hot water and heating are available, although you might need to restart the boiler once in a while =)
The neighborhood is quiet, the apartment is a 5 minute walk from Istiklal and 10 minute walk to Taksim, bus stations are nearby
Overall it was a nice experience

Verda's apartment is very nice to stay at! It is well equipped, spacious, and very comfortable. The bed is comfortable and there is key kitchen equipment for cooking. It's close to Taksim Square and other attractions. Right nearby are two grocery stores and a few restaurants. Verda and her husband are great hosts. They are very friendly and helpful. We would definitely recommend staying here!

Daire aslında güzeldi fakat 3.kata çıkmak hele ki bavul benzeri eşyaları dar merdivenlerden çıkarıp indirmek gerçekten zordu binanın konumu istiklal caddesine yakın fakat biraz eski bir bina olduğunu zemin döşemesinden hissedebiliyordunuz. Konumu açısından iyi sayılabilir fakat semt biraz metruk kalıyor yatak da iki tek kişilik yatağın yan yana getirilmesi ile oluşturulmuştu bundan dolayı pek rahat sayılmazdı ama daha iyi fiyat performans yerler de bulunabilir.

description: The apartment enjoys a special location in the city, close to commercial and shopping centers (Trump Towers and Cevahir mall), banks, cinemas, theaters and arts centres. You can easily reach the E5, metro, metrobus, which is one of the main transportation routes in Istanbul. There is a washing machine, kitchen, microwave, oven, air conditioner, smartTV and refrigerator in our place. Facilities offered include free Wi-Fi and free parking.

reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay at this place. The location is excellent, very convenient and close to public transportation, shops, and restaurants. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described.
The host was very kind, responsive, and helpful whenever we needed anything, which made our stay even more pleasant. The check-in and check-out process was smooth and easy.
Overall, we felt very comfortable and safe during our stay, and we would definitely choose this place again in the future. Highly recommended for anyone visiting the area!

Metro, metrobüs ve otobüs duraklarına çok yakın. Arabamızı otoparka park edip toplu ulaşımla her yere hızlı ve sorunsuzca ulaşabildik.
Odalar, banyo, yatak ve havlular temizdi. Asansörün çalışma sesi biraz rahatsız etse de uyunamayacak gibi değildi.
Özetle, aracıyla İstanbul’a gelip otopark aramak ve otoparklara bir dünya para ödemek istemeyenlere öneririm

Kaldığım süreçte gercekten hem Ottaman Residence dan hem de çalışanlarından memnun kaldım. Hatta seyahatimi uzattığımda da bana oda ayarlamalari çok kolay oldu. Lokasyon açısından gerçekten çok kolay erişilebilir bir konumda. Metro, metrobus 5 dk sürmüyor bile. Hergun temizlik hizmeti vermeleri harikaydı. İlk gün kalışta benim rezervasyon yaptigimdan başka bir odada kaldım, bir sonraki gün benim rezervasyon ettiğime geçecektim ancak o oda da gayet güzel ve rahattı. Sonra değiştirmek istemedim ve o konuda da kolaylikla yardımcı oldular. Kesinlikle gelecek tüm misafirlere bu yeri 100% öneriyorum.

fiyat performans gayet güzel herşey dedikleri resimdeki gibi çıktı önyargı ile gittim ama çok memnun kaldım çok iyi insanlar tekrar teşekkürler Osman bey hangi konu olursa hep yardımcı oluyorlar çözüm sunuyorlar sıkıntı yaşamadık yer olarakta metroya yakın AVM yakın tekrar İstanbul a gidecek olursam başka yere hiç bakmam gönül rahatlığıyla tercih edebilirsiniz
Gayet güzeldi aynen fotoğraflarda gösterildiği gibiydi ve temizdi. Güler yüzlü ve sıcakkanlıydı ev sahibi güzel bir deneyimdi.

description: Residence Inn Istanbul Ataşehir offers you well-furnished studios, spacious one-bedroom suites, suites with jacuzzi with magnificent sea views, and a Presidential Suite with many facilities such as sauna and Turkish bath. Whether you're with us for a few days, a few weeks, or a few months, your daily routine is important to us. Relax in our suites with fully equipped kitchens, separate seating areas, sofa beds, work areas, smart TVs and high-speed Wi-Fi.

reviews.text: The location is pleasant, but there’s a nightclub on the 14th floor that isn’t mentioned during check-in. The noise level is unbearable and will prevent you from sleeping. Initially, I was told it was a private party for one night. The next day, they said a different company managed the club, but they would inform management. By the third day, they admitted it was an official nightclub that they had no control over, and it had just opened three days prior. This was only after I asked for recommendations for clubs. If it weren't for the noise keeping me awake for three nights straight, my stay would have been enjoyable. You're paying over $100 a night for a clean place where you can't sleep.
Nice hotel with helpful staff, and quiet neighborhood.
tertemiz düzgün ve modern bir yer. umarım fiyatlar çok artmaz. teşekkürler.
Fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibi temiz ve düzenli bir otel. Personel çok ilgili ve güler yüzlüydü. Memnun kaldım.
All the hotel and staff were so kind and helpful. It was a great trip for us. Thank you for your support.

description: 1st-floor apartment home, fresh renovated and totally private - Not shared. Kitchen including basic utensils. Dining area with table seating for 10 Living room with sleeper sofa, chairs, end tables, flat-screen Smart TV, Bluetooth, and Wifi compatible. One full bath with shower, complete with toiletries and towels.

reviews.text: Mert was an excellent host. Very flexible with check in and departure times. Great location, in a quiet area and close to the tram. Large space and was well equipped. Air conditioning worked through the apartment which was great. Beds and pillows were okay. The only negative feedback is that the apartment wasn’t very clean. In saying this, the apartment was good value for money so if this isn’t important to you then this place is perfect.

Overall our stay was decent. The apartment is on the first floor - there are about twenty steps overall to get to the apartment, checking in was easy and Mert communicated very well with us throughout our trip.. the apartment is clean, however the shower tends to leak water through the shower so had to put a few towels on the floor after every shower. Unfortunately the washing machine turns off when the lights of the bathroom turn off which meant my clothes stopped in the machine mid cycle drenched in water overnight. Mert was good to sort it out the next morning . One of the bedroom contains a boiler which can be noisy at times.
The location is good - it’s close to Tophane tr station and 6 minutes away from Istiklal road ( but it’s a bit of steep climb getting there). Overall enjoyed our stay and our host Mert was lovely.

It was a nice stay. Apartments are in an amazing neighborhood, you can find plenty of cafes/restaurants/design shops and beautiful streets nearby. This location has a great transport infrastructure. The apartments were clean and nice with all you need to spend decent 10 days in Istanbul (with a great Wifi by the way). The host was very helpful and communication was great.
Although, there were several issues which I have to say about. First of all - the third room (the smallest) doesn't have real windows, it's the windows into another room (into something like a storage room). Second of all - the floor is cold and freezy in the common area (kitchen and living room).

The shower cabin was dirty and smelled bad. The couch also smelled bad because smoking is allowed in the apartment, and overall it smelled like cigarettes. The location and communication with the owner were okay.

We were a group of 6 adults and 2 kids. The place was perfect for us. The location was very good, 10 mins walking distance to Istiklal street and to Galata tower. Mert and Izel were very helpful and responsive all the time. There was issue with the shower, they sent someone to fix it within an hour. It was a very pleasant stay and we will definitely consider the place if we come back again as a group. Note: for elderly ppl, there is a stairs on the way to Istiklal street which might not be convenient to them.

description:
Enjoy a stylish experience in this centrally located place.
This is an aparthotel.
Apartments are provided according to the number of people you choose
Apartments vary according to price

reviews.text: The Best host, commucation is very good and fast. The app has all you need, fast WiFi, the location is perfect for living in, all the shops, clinic, atm, bus station, seaside, all around here in 5 min walking.
Tres bon hote avec une bonne communication et très serviable et nous a toujours répondu tres vite merci beaucoup

Ben normalde başka bir yere rezervasyon yapmıştım. Ancak ev sahibi benimle temasa geçmediği için rezervasyonumu iptal edip son dakikada Barış beyin evini rezerve ettim. Kendisi benimle hemen temasa geçerek bir çok tavsiyede ve öneride bulundu. Çok samimi ve içten davrandı. Evinde kendi evimdeymişim gibi konakladım. Harika bir ev sahibi. Kesinlikle tavsiye ederim. Kendisine de teşekkür ederim.
Sahibine bizi kabul ettiği için çok minnettarım, otel mükemmel, konumu iyi ve her şey yakın
Baris was a great host! Very accommodative! We definitely recommend this place to anyone!

description: Our house is only 3 minutes away by walking to İstiklal Street and Şişhane Metro Station. You'll be right in the middle of the city, with easy access to shopping, good food, and easy transportation. This is a 2 bedroom house, with every necessary equipments in it to make you feel comfortable(including high signal WI-FI, AC, SMART TV with Netflix and Amazon Prime , dishwasher etc.). House is all yours, enjoy!

reviews.text:
The location is good, in an alley, close to the main street, and the building has an elevator. The apartment is spacious and comfortable for 4 adults, and check-in was smooth. Heating was promptly turned on when requested.
Some noise could be heard at night, one window didn’t close fully, and a few amenities mentioned in the listing, like shampoo, soap, a toaster, and a coffee maker, were not available. The host initially promised to fix window and provide some of the items, but windiw was not fixed andthey didn’t arrive. The oven and chairs could have been cleaner.
Communication was the issue. Messages about amenities, vacuum, and airport transfer were not answered. Even a short acknowledgment would have been reassuring, as it helps guests feel supported. Even Airbnb shows an average response time of 11 hours for the host, which is long. Faster communication would improve the experience.
With better cleaning, ensured amenities, and quicker responses, this property has great potenti

We had a wonderful stay at Alp’s place. He was a great Host and was very responsive. Anything that we needed, he made sure to try and accommodate as fast as possible. There was great communication and he was always checking in on us.
The location of the apartment is great, close to a well-stocked store downstairs and walking distance to lots of local hotspots (great to explore at all times). There were good bus and Metro connections too, for easy use of public transport. The apartment itself looks like the pictures and was squeaky-clean upon arrival.
Our stay at Alp’s place and in Istanbul were both lovely. We can’t say thank you enough!

We visited Istanbul at the end of June. Our accommodation was clean and modern and close to Istiklal, as described. We were happy with the location and its proximity to taxi services and local conveniences. Alp was extremely helpful and had gone well beyond our expectations to provide additional services to us, like transportation means and routes, advice on how to optimize on time and get the most out of the travel experience. As all travellers would know, it's extremely difficult to lug all your travel luggage throughout Istanbul. Never mind that,Alp was so kind that he offered to store our primary luggage bags filled with shopping goods in his basement for a week, while we toured other regions of Turkey.
I cannot re-iterate his levels of kindness,helpfulness and integrity. He refused to take a cent from us for assisting us with our storage .
Alp remained friendly and accessible throughout our journey and we would recommend his service to all. BASICALLY ALP IS THE WORLDS BEST HOST 😁

We really enjoyed our stay here. Alp is an excellent host. He was very helpful and replied almost instantly. He checked when we were on our way and had someone meet us at the property. Nothing was too much bother and he gave us plenty of local recommendations as well as directions when we were out and lost. The place was lovely and clean and all amenities as described. Generally, the flat was a little smaller than expected from photos but was not an issue. All rooms were as described and we had a comfortable stay. It’s in a great location to walk to Istiklal street and easy to halt taxis to. Small shop just outside the property meant we could get anything we needed at any time and the kebab shop next door is a must-try!

My family and I stayed at Alp’s place for 3 nights, and we loved everything about the place. The house was clean, cozy and looked exactly like in the pictures. There was a hiccup at first in finding the place but Alp was very patient in guiding the directions. Didn’t get to meet Alp but his cousin/friend was also kind and helped us to check in. There is no parking on the site road but Alp suggested nearby otopark for us to park our vehicle. We loved that there’s a grocery store and good kebab place just next to the building. The location of the place is just 10 minutes walk to Taksim and Istiklal Street, and from there just another 15-20 minutes walk (downhill) to Galata tower. Overall we had a good stay here. Thank you Alp!

description:
Our new houses, located on the most decent street of Nişantaşı, 75 meters from the American hospital, 400 meters from Osmanbey metro station, within walking distance of Maçka park and congress center, are modern and designed with all your needs in mind. Our building is within walking distance of the most beautiful restaurants, cafes and shops.
In Nişantaşı, the heart of Istanbul, it is our greatest happiness to give you the comfort and confidence of your home

reviews.text: Fotoğraflarda görüldüğü gibi ev. Konumu çok merkezi. Apartman ve ev temiz düzenliydi. İlgili ve alakalı bir ev sahibi. Tekrar geldiğimde kullanmayı düşünebileceğim bir yer.

Muhit süper heryere yakın metro 6-7 dk mesafede. Nişantaşı’nın göbeğinde. Katlı otopark var fakat sokakta ücretsiz park edebileceğim yerler var.Çok güvenli sakin bir sokakta. Fakat 2-3 dk mesafede eğlence yerleri de var. Süperdi tavsiye ediyorum
We had what we wanted. The location is great, in the heart of Nisantasi and yet inside is quiet and peaceful like you are outside the city. Murat was very responsive and helpful. Recommend it.
Great location 📍 Host was easy to communicate with and very responsive.

This was a great experience both times-love love this place. Emrah was super responsive and even delivers extra blankets late at night. Insulation is also great as you don't hear the neighbors and apartments look to the garden in the back so its quiet. I will stay here again. The only thing is the first apartment needs more dishes. The location is perfect close to everything including subway.
