reviews.text: Konum, metro ve otobüs gibi ulaşım araçlarına oldukça yakındı. Bölge güvenli, nezih ve birçok kafe, restoran, dükkana yakındı. Tek gece konaklamamıza rağmen çoğu ihtiyacımızı karşıladı. Küçük ama 4 kişinin rahatlıkla kalabileceği bir yer. Çok büyük bir sorun teşkil etmese de, evde bırakılan havlulardan 1 tanesi yırtıktı. 3 kişi olduğumuz için çok sıkıntı olmadı ama yırtık bir havlunun konmasının iyi bir izlenim yarattığını düşünmüyorum. Duş jeli mevcut yazdığı halde yoktu, tek gece olduğu için dert değildi, idare ettik. En olumsuz bulduğumuz kısım ise tuvalet gibi hijyen olması gereken bir yeri kirli ve lekeli bulmamızdı. Genel olarak evden memnun kaldık. Gerek ulaşıma, gerek diğer bölgelere olan yakınlığına, gerekse civardaki yeme-içme, dükkan alternatifleri açısından büyük artı.

First of all, Murat is a nice and helpful host. He understands occasional problems and does his best to assist with them. He was also fair and understanding when we decided to cancel, charging only for two days of a seven-day booking — which we really appreciated.
That said, this apartment is not really a proper flat you’d prefer for a family stay, especially with a baby. It feels more like a two-room hotel unit rather than a home. The whole building seems to be used for short-term rentals and is not kept in the best condition.
Cleanliness could be improved — we found some breadcrumbs on the table and a few hairs in the bed.
Nevertheless, the location is fantastic, close to everything and very convenient.
good location nice host and good apartment as described.

The apartment is located in great neighborhood. 4 min walk from city’s nisintasi, but on quiet street. The apartment itself was okay, clean, free of clutter. They also changed our towels and cleaned once per 2 days. However, the apartment is not well soundproofed. We could hear neighbors above walking and noises from cars on the street. For those who are sensitive sleepers - might be a trouble to fall asleep. The bedsheets were clean, however very synthetic, which is not pleasant to the body and feels hot at night. Other than that apartment is good.

Great location, fairly quiet though, everything you need is within 200 meters., even a mall and a hospital. The bedrooms are of good size, the beds are comfy, the living area is not too spacious but convenient. Big pro is the place has an elevator, you only might need to carry your suitcases a few steps and the guy at building/reception is willing to help. We travelled with a baby and left the stroller downstairs and it was fine.

description:
I am Shiva :) I am a perfect host :) Now relax. Get yourself together. Let go of all the thoughts in your mind. Let the world around you disappear in uncertainty. You are about to embark on a perfect holiday :)


This place is close to Taksim Square, Galataport, Galata Tower, Metro, Tram, bus stops, pier, Hospital, bars, restaurants, Istanbul Bosphorus, Historical peninsula, Hagia Sophia, Sultanahmet.

Here is the heart of the city. You can walk to all the entertainment centers in minutes.

Thank you

reviews.text:
This is a nicely decorated studio in a great location. Be advised it is best for one person to stay, or a long-established couple, as there are no doors between the two different spaces and the bathroom (including toilet and shower) is effectively in the bedroom. There was a bit of a musty smell throughout the place, and inadequate ventilation for air circulation.
We weren't given enough bedding to start with, but Shiva arranged for more to be delivered to us straight away when we requested it the following day. Good comms from the host (very responsive) but overall the studio felt a little bodged together and our nightly fee seemed expensive for what it was.

I can’t really say this apartment was good enough. There were some positives: the location is perfect, Shiva was kind and always available, everything was clean, and the huge bottle of drinking water was a nice touch. The kitchen was well equipped.
But there were also many downsides. A lot of the things shown in the photos either didn’t exist or were broken. For example, the shower head didn’t work (only the rain shower did). The sink was replaced with a very tiny one. Fine for washing hands, but impossible to wash your face without splashing water all over your legs. There was no bench in the hallway, no wardrobe, no bedside table, or storage, just a single rail, so our things were scattered everywhere. The bed was extremely small for two, and the mattress sat deep inside the frame, so we kept bumping our knees.
Overall, it was a disappointing experience

A very pleasant stay in the center. Close to Istiklal, but not noisy (maybe a couple cars passing by). Easy access to metro, many sights close by. Lots of little cafés to have breakfast.
The apartment is slightly smaller than we thought, but it wasn´t a problem. We were 3 people, sleeping on the couch was comfortable enough. The bathroom door is fully glass! Make sure the people you travel with are comfortable with that :)
The kitchen is fully equipped, everything is very cute and in in a perfect working order. Very clean! And a really cozy space in general.

We loved staying at the apartment - it was clean, tidy and situated at a nice location close to numerous restaurants and cafes that serve great breakfast.
Self check-in was also super convenient.
One thing I should note - there are no curtains in the bathroom, so whoever's resting on the bed can see you taking a shower, but for couples that could be a cool feature :)
Ideal location of the apartment in a good area and a very pleasant host. Excellent internet. But it seemed to me that the price for such an apartment is too high. Not very comfortable living.

description:
YOU WILL BE CLOSE TO EVERYWHERE SINCE YOUR HOME IN ISTANBUL IS CENTRALLY LOCATED.
RESTAURANT, GROCERY STORE, CAFE, PHARMACY, BANK, SCHOOL, TRAM, METRO, DOLMUSH, BUS, SEA TRANSPORTATION, ISTANBUL KENT UNIVERSITY, BEYKENT UNIVERSITY, MIMAR SINAN UNIVERSITY, GALATASARAY UNIVERSITY, TAKSIM SQUARE AND GALATAPORT ARE WITHIN WALKING DISTANCE.
WE LOOK FORWARD TO WELCOMING YOU TO YOUR HOME IN ISTANBUL AS SOON AS POSSIBLE...

reviews.text: I had a great stay at this Airbnb. It’s ver clean and conveniently close to Taksim Square and the subway. There are plenty of cafes and restaurants nearby. The apartment has few stairs, but Huseyin, the host, helped with my luggage. The street can be a bit noisy, but it added to the lively atmosphere.
Great location with a lovely view. Everything was clean and as described. Perfect for a getaway in Istanbul.

Konforlu, Temiz ve Lüks bir ev. Konum olarak merkezi bir yerde. Çalışma alanı rahat, ve mobilyalar konforlu. Hüseyin Bey dost canlısı ve çözüm odaklı bir ev sahibi. İstanbul konaklamaları için tercih edeceğim bir yer, tavsiye ederim.

As a digital nomad, this place met my needs perfectly. Great wifi, relaxing environment and nice view. Great location! I walked everywhere for food and sightseeing. The host was extremely friendly and very helpful. I would highly recommend 👍

strongly recommend.
-good location.5 minutes walk to T1 tram stop and most of sightseeing spots such as blue mosque are on T1 line
-the house has lift,no worry if you have big luggage
-the room is big and new,all facilities are available,good view from balcony.quite at night
-the host is very nice ang helpful

description:
This is a private studio in a 200-year-old building with a breathtaking city view from the shared balcony. You'll have your own room and bathroom for a comfortable stay.

You're just a short distance away from some of Istanbul's top attractions:
Spice Bazaar:8 minutes
Suleymaniye Mosque:7 minutes
Hagia Sophia & Blue Mosque:25 minutes
Grand Bazaar:10 minutes
Golden Horn metro station:3 minutes
Galata Tower:15 minutes
Cibali Tram:10 minutes
Eminonu tram and ferries:10 minutes
Balat:25 minutes

reviews.text:
Overall: good value for the price, but certainly has downsides that may sour the experience.
The good:
- Positioning: near metro station, near many tourist attractions, near a pier;
- Price: very cheap compared to other options in the area;
- Great host: very responsive, great instructions;
- Cleaning and supplies: cleaning was available every weekday, bottled water, tea and coffee always available.
The bad:
- Audibility: it's a wooden building, so you hear everything your neighbours and staff do and say. Even walking sends thuds to other rooms;
- The state of the apartment: walls look a bit scuffed and dirty, one part of our apartment was a bit slumped down due to the way the building settled;
- Weird noises coming from a wall between our apartment and the hallway: we heard what sounded like small rodents in the walls rattling around. Banging on the walls stopped it temporarily;
- The area: it's bazaar-like, very busy, can be intimidating;
- Draft from windows: can get chilly.

The host was super lovely, but he did not inform us that the warm water was broken. We stayed two nights and we were unable to take a warm shower. The water was cold. The place is very old. It has its charm, but with the cold water and the dirty pillows and the dirty surfaces in the kitchen, walls and bathroom it was very uncomfortable and I did not rest well. That said, the host felt very bad about the water not working and he had an engineer coming over every day to try and fix it and he even offered me to shower elsewhere for free. The location is superb And it’s right in the middle of the authentic old town near all the right places with a wonderful view from the balcony. I left tired and cold, but it was an unlucky incident among many other plus points.

Comfortable stay in a great location. Comfy bed, spacious room with sofa/desk/wardrobe and a nice kitchen and bathroom with an easy to use shower too. Very friendly host with easy to navigate check in/instructions for our stay. A good location close to shops/eateries. only a 30 minute walk to Galata tower one way and 30 minutes to Hagia Sofia the other way - also close to a metro. Only downside was the noise. The room isn't very soundproof as we could hear anyone and everything from outside at all hours and could hear the footsteps from the person staying above us. So a cosy conveniently located apartment at a very good price that we would recommend, just be weary of the noise which may disturb your sleep if you're a light sleeper.

The house is quaint & traditional. Not for ones with weak knees or legs as the rooms are mostly upstairs with steep narrow steps. Room was ok, nice comfy bed, small kitchen and washroom. comfortable for 2 persons stay.
Location is terrific, with attractions all walking distances. Food & shops are nearby and more affordable then main area of Istanbul (Sultanahmet etc).
Only thing is, host was too slow in responding to our concerns and was not so interested in communicating with us when we introduced ourselves and saying we are comming and would it be ok to give us a tour as he stated in his listings. We were always left on read in text..or just left unanswered for hours and hours. Both in the chat app and here in airbnb message space. very frustrating.
Maybe next time should be more approachable
But overall our stay was ok..simple yet good.

Spent 6 days at Kalens, great location!
this accommodation is for the adventurous, not for the faint hearted! it is clean and comfortable enough, and our host was always happy to answer questions and assist with minor issues. We stayed in the top level room 401 with an amazing view across the Bosphorus to the Galata Tower. We walked to all of the main attractions, and when we returned we grabbed some beers and sat on the balcony watching the boats go by.
There is always water available as well as laundry facilities and Kalen even took us on a free walking tour for a couple of hours. Thanks Kalen, we really appreciated your kind and attentive hospitality.

description:
Indulge in the exquisite allure of the ''Bestekar'' Apartment, a stunning abode that has been meticulously crafted and newly constructed in 2021.

You'll be greeted by stylish finishes and top-of-the-line appliances that are sure to make your stay comfortable and convenient. Each room is equipped with air conditioning to ensure that you have a cool stay.

Whether you're looking to relax or explore, the newly constructed ''Bestekar'' has everything you need to make the most of your stay

reviews.text: Most amazing hosts ! The apartment is absolutely perfect. It has everything you need to feel like home. It’s clean, bed sleeps so comfortably, has a washer and is decorated beautifully looks just like the photos. Building is new with secure entry. Check in was so easy and stress free. WiFi works great and fast . Locals and neighbors are so helpful and kind. Great restaurants , supermarket , cafe right within walking distance. Less than 100 ft. Hosts are wonderful and responsive . I’m so happy with my stay and will love to stay again ! Book it ! You won’t regret.

I had a wonderful stay! The apartment is located in a very peaceful area. Everything inside the apartment was brand new, clean, and thoughtfully arranged, making it truly comfortable and enjoyable to stay in. Аttention was paid to every detail. The host was also very responsive and helpful, answering any questions quickly and making sure I had everything I needed. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to others looking for a quiet and modern place to stay.

I want to thank the owner of this cool apartment for providing me with comfort and coziness throughout the time of LordLand.
The owner of the apartment was very polite , cultured , provided me with all the amenities
I was in a very cozy, clean space with a good location, there were establishments and supermarkets in close access around me.
I especially want to appreciate the cleanliness, repair, Internet speed, I want to thank you separately for the opportunity to keep my luggage in extra time. Definitely if I come to Istanbul again I will live here
I advise everyone!

We had a great stay here. Loved the location and the quality of the accommodation. Everything was clean, the kitchen was well equipped, the bedroom was large and the living room space was perfect. Great for a long or short stay.

Everything was clear and comfortable. Thank you for your hospitality.
But there was one problem, when someone is cooking in apartment, in the rooms was smell. I think you have to fix kitchen hoods.

description:
200 meters from taksim square so if you want to go to shopping centers or public transportations, all you need is to walk to taksim...
We are here 24 hours so if you are coming at night it's not a problem
Full kitchen, electric stove, microwave,, cutlery , pots and pans.
In thıs room six people can stay but there is No lift/ elevator, Only Stairs. no worries about your bags our staff will help you
If you stay in this centrally located place, you'll be close to everything as a family.

reviews.text:
The apartment’s location is excellent, making it very convenient for getting around. Murat and his coworkers were incredibly friendly and helpful, even assisting us with carrying our luggage to the 5th floor since the building doesn’t have an elevator. Both the train and bus stations are very close to the apartment, which was a big plus.
The bedroom was very comfortable, and the kitchen was well-equipped, allowing us to cook our own meals. The only downside was that the bathroom furniture is outdated and need some renovation.
Evin merkezi konumu sayesinde herhangi bir yere giderken oldukça rahat ettik. Geç saatte gelmemize rağmen check-in yapmamıza da imkan sağladıkları için teşekkür ederiz
temizdi, eşyalar eskiydi, konum merkezi ama sesli ve güvenlik soru işaratiydi girişte ve çıkışta yardımcı olundu asansörsüz çıkması zor merdivenler odalar sıcaktı
Murat great host
Every things is good 👍

description:
Yours alone all five(5) floors of it.

This rare 4-bedroom Istanbul villa sits at the heart of the city, moments from Taksim Square, Istiklal Street, and the bohemian charm of Cihangir and Çukurcuma.

Designed for families, groups, film productions, and corporate retreats who refuse to compromise every floor offers space, privacy, and character. The kind of stay where everyone truly settles in.

Not a hotel. Not an apartment. Your own private corner of Istanbul.

reviews.text: We had a fantastic stay at this Airbnb during our visit to Istanbul! The location was perfect, just a short walk to Taksim Square, surrounded by great restaurants, shopping, and so much more. It made exploring the city so convenient! The apartment itself was exactly as described in the listing—clean, well-equipped, and comfortable. The host was incredibly responsive and helpful, always quick to answer any questions we had and made sure our stay was smooth. We couldn’t have asked for a better place to stay. Highly recommend!

I recently stayed at this Airbnb and had a mixed experience. The host was friendly and spoke good English, which made communication easy. However, the place was significantly smaller than it appeared in the photos, and the house itself was much older than depicted, along with the furnishings.
One major issue was the presence of a lot of drain flies, especially on the ground floor and the basement, which made the stay quite uncomfortable. Additionally, With this price, I believe I could have found a much better place, especially since the cleanliness was not up to standard.
Tolga is a great host. During our stay he was very attentive. The place has a great location and it is as described. Can’t wait to stay here again in our next visit to Istanbul.

Nice house and host. Tolga was responsive and a very friendly host. The house was clean and met our expectations from the pictures and description. I recommend to stay here, especially if you are a larger group. Overall great stay.

Perfect location to visit Istanbul’s main attractions. The are is full of nice bars and restaurants. The flat was spacious and clean. The host was welcoming, friendly, responsive and flexible. Highly recommended.

description: From this centrally located place, you can easily access everything as a whole group. A decent residence with a shopping mall, world brands, food, drinks, clothing, cinema and market below

reviews.text: Very responsive and friendly host. Nice and clean unit with a very accurate location, close to many shops and restaurants. Well recommended.

The view was fabulous, and the experience of being on the 49th floor was amazing. The room in general was clean. Also, Mr. Can is a good host. He was helpful and easy to communicate with throughout the stay.
Great apartment and hosts. Apartment is spacious and clean with all amenities required. The hosts are easy to contact and reply very quickly.

Level 49 life experience in modern surrounding area.
Just consider there is no metro line around but bus and taxi is easily accessible.

Can beyin dairesi temiz ve konforluydu. Lokasyon olarak Ataşehir'de her şeyin merkezinde bir daire. Manzara sevenler için de çok hoş görseller vadediyor. Can beyle iletişim kolay ve sorunsuz. Tavsiye ederim.

description: Private cozy flat, 5 min from Istiklal, in the heart of the city

reviews.text:
I recently rented this room in the Blue Room 1 for a 3-night stay, and it exceeded my expectations. The room was clean and well-maintained - offering a comfortable retreat after a day of exploring the city!
The location was less than 2 mins away from a bus stop, making it easy to access all the attractions and restaurants I needed. The host was friendly and responsive and I had a pleasant stay.
Overall, a great value for the price, and I would definitely consider staying here again on my next visit to Beyoğlu, Turkey.

I had to make a last minute booking due to my previous host being incompetent so I was extremely pleased at being able to check in easily and find the accommodation exactly as described.
Great value, very helpful staff, ideal location.
A good example of how a budget Airbnb should be run.
Recommended

My experience here was unfortunately disappointing. I originally booked the place for one week, but due to an unexpected issue I had to cancel my stay on the second day. I followed the official process and canceled after the checkout time according to the platform rules. Even though I was still charged for four nights plus the service fee, the host called me around 7 PM and told me that I needed to leave within 30 minutes. This was quite stressful and confusing, especially since I had already paid for additional days.
Another thing future guests may want to consider is the surrounding area. Personally, I did not feel very comfortable with the neighborhood, especially at night. The building itself is quite old and some of the nearby buildings appear abandoned or in poor condition. The staircase inside the building is also very narrow and steep, which might be difficult for some guests, particularly with luggage.
Overall, the stay did not meet my expectations.

I've visited Istanbul 8 times in the past 2 years. I stayed next door to Parmida's last trip, 5 weeks this trip, so over 2 months total in this exact location. Sure, the house opposite is condemned, but this location is one of the best I have stayed, which is why I returned. This entire neighbourhood is NOT dangerous, its where real people live, learn a little Turkish and everyone you meet will not stop talking to you. I felt very safe day and night. You're close to supermarkets, the whole street is a market every Sunday, the main bus routes are just steps away, but you get none of the road noise. The wi-fi worked very well, the kitchen is sparse so take what you need, the bed, shower, fridge all work well as does the heating. The table and chairs could be improved, but the centre of Istanbul is right there, almost everywhere is a single bus ride away, the call-to-prayer is audible, but not in your face at 6am so you're Istanbul-immersed, there's a lot to like about Parmida's.

Good things:
- While receptionist doesn’t speak English he was very helpful (we used translator app to communicate)
- Ida was available via messages all the time and was ready to answer my questions and help me out. I really appreciate her help related to many things Istanbul
- Bus stop is near that can take you to many places around the city
- There are a lot of places to get food and drink coffee nearby.
- Taksim square with lots of restaurants shops bars etc is within walking distance
Bad things:
- Area looks really sketchy so it was bit of a shock at first but you get used to it.
- Room/Apartment was bit dusty when I came in. Nothing disgusting but it looked like no one visited it several days prior my coming. It wasn’t great first impression. Towels and linens were super clean, can’t complain about those.
- Sound isolation is almost nonexistent so if you are light sleeper like me - you may have issues with other people being loud inside the building.
Thank you for having me!

description:
In order to offer our guests an unforgettable accommodation experience, we have restored a 130-year-old historical building in a stylish and comfortable way.
Please note: This room has a private bathroom, but it is not within the room but directly across from it.
Attention: the floors and ceilings of our building are wooden and there may be sound passages between floors. Our building is suitable for those who prefer a peaceful stay and is not suitable for events

reviews.text: amazing space, comby bed, very well decorated, loved the big mirror, really romantic. I found it just expensive to have paid more as a couple instead of single, and expensive cleaning fees, and for an exterior toilet the room must be half the price even if it's private, we kept bumping into people going up and down with just our towel on. Location was amazing though...we got water cut in the toilet which was also annoying as we just stayed 2 nights...if we get a discount I will be happier, I felt I just over paid for exterior toilet and water cut. thank you.

A friend and I travelled to Istanbul together and stayed in this room. It is approx. 1.5 hours from IST airport, about 1 hour to SAW airport. It is very close to ferry terminals, and we used this to get to other parts of the city. This room felt very cozy with its decor, lighting, and amenities, with a shared mini fridge downstairs, house slippers, and easy entry/exit. The reviews are true: you will hear noise from others, but staying in this restored home is absolutely worth it. Engin is a very responsive and kind host and he makes excellent coffee; if you get the chance to sit down with him and chat, definitely do. The sofa bed in the room is comfy, as is the bed. The desk area works great for remote work, while looking out on the street, and the WiFi definitely supports report work; I did several hour-long video calls without issue. The room fit the description well. I would absolutely stay here again.

Ev sahibi çok ilgiliydi kesinlikle tavsiye ediyoruz her konuda yardımcı oldu ve her an iletişim halindeydi herhangi bir ihtiyaç sorun var mı diye ev ile alakalı yorum yapmak gerekirse konumu dizaynı rahatlığı ve temizliği en üst seviyedeydi konaklamak için gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ediyoruz

I had a wonderful stay and I’m truly very satisfied with both the space and the host. The place was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and well taken care of. The host was kind, responsive, and very helpful throughout my stay, making the whole experience even better. I would definitely recommend staying here!

Very cozy and beautiful room. Really love the decoration and the vibe!
Host was super kind and responsive. He recommended a lot things to do in Kadikoy, one of the most lovely area in Istanbul.
The location is very centered in Kadikoy and it’s super easy for me to walk around the beautiful place, find some really nice bars and cafes.
Highly recommend if you want to experience a more local life here!
The only cons is the sound insulation is not that good as it’s an old building. You can hear people upstairs walk around. But the guests there are all very polite and I wasn’t bothered during my sleep. Also the price is really good.

description: Apartment is on the 1st floor of the 2floor building, which has acces by car right to the entrance door. Location is great, very easy to visit most of central places by feet or to find a transport. Taxim Sq., Istiklal Ave., Galata Tower, "Taxim" & "Sishane" metro stops, bus stops are in walking distance. Cause of this central location there are many markets, restaurants, pubs, and etc.which are open (7×24) whole day.

reviews.text:
Eltaj was very kind and helpful. He met me to hand over the key and sent over several recommendations for restaurants. I appreciate that the host let me book for the same day after an issue at my last Airbnb.
Pros: Large apartment with nice simple furnishings. Central and close to Istiklal street. Safe and walkable. Close to grocery stores. Full sized fridge with freezer. Strong wifi. Large windows everywhere that provide a good breeze and sunlight. Separate shower area (unlike many apartments with showers directly over the toilet in Istanbul). Washer in unit.
Cons: Kitchen was ill-equipped. The only cooking utensil upon arrival was a soup ladle, although I was later provided with a spatula and wooden spoon. The bathroom window can’t be open while showering as it provides a direct view into the shower. Brightly lit streets that shine into the apartment (Eltaj kindly provided darker curtains for the bedroom after request).
Overall would recommend for weeklong or shorter stays.

Gurubish is the perfect host. She's polite and friendly, she immediately answers all questions and gives you a list of recommendations (to have breakfast or diner, to buy turkish delight etc.).
This apartment is located in a quiet place. There are a lot of grocery stores and local cafes where you can dine in or take away. It's a good place if you want to go sightseeing. For example, it takes like 5 min to get to Istiklal Caddesi or around 15 min to Taksim Square. Also there is a bus stop near the house so you can get everywhere you want to. We bought Istanbulkart at the metro station so we travelled using only public transport.
The apartment was very clean, cozy and well equipped (iron, hairdryer, fridge, washing machine, towels, two kettles, frying pans, cutlery, nice dishes, wine glasses). There is also a tiny balcony but the weather was cold so we didn't spend much time there.
We had a great time living here!

We were happy to stay in this flat.
It is very well located, you can easily walk to Istiklal. Product stores (Carrefour, Şok) are near as well.
The flat is clean and very cute:)
The Internet was fast. There were no problems with water, hitting or something else. There was all the kitchen stuff we needed.
Gurubish and Eltaj were kind and ready to help when we asked.
Highly recommend!)

My experience was not bad at all . Fidan is a good person in communication especially at check in time and she sent us a list of places as recommendation to help us . The place is very enough fir two person and about 300 m from Istklal street and 600 m from Taksim square. The place was clean and well equipped except two things ( it needs curtains to block the sunlight and the place needs air conditioner or even fan in summer times). We asked Fidan for iron she get one for us the day after . One note to take care that there is workshops surrounding that make noise. The area has some weird people at night so any girl being alone just take care of it .

Really cute apartment, more then fair price, really friendly hosts.
Thanks a lot Fidan and Eltaj for the great stay :))

description: Keep it simple at this peaceful and centrally-located place.

reviews.text: Excellent value. The apartment is centrally located and within a short walking distance to lots of coffee shops and restaurants. It is also very close to the ferry to get you to the European side, which I was doing almost daily. The place was clean, very comfortable, and communication with the host was quick and effective.

I was happy with the cost. I paid for a weeks accommodation. I also travelled into central Turkey so I didn't sleep there the whole time. When I arrived by taxi. I was dropped off at the right place but because the entrance at street level did appear rather dodgy. I didnt push open the front door. I eventually went upstairs to my rental. it was about 70 steps. I am over 60+ and not very fit. I got help with my bags. This did help me a lot. There were issues inside apartment. The thermostat was faulty. I had cold showers. The bathroom had mould. The drawers were broken. The bed was very low to the ground and very hard. The washing machine didn't work. There were no cupboards to hang clothing but there was a small stand. I was a bit disappointed as the apartment decor was not exactly as it was presented online on the Airbnb platform. I wouldn't come back here. I would ensure there was a lift next time. Carrying so many bags up stairs and downstairs in narrow stairs is difficult

Don't dear to rent this apartment! The bathroom was full of hair when we entered, there where no hangers for towels. The building itself is disgusting, the hall has smell of mold and is so much dirty... The stairs will kill you even without luggage if you are not fit enough. The water boiler used to leak sometimes. The iron had burnt surface and couldn't be used. The bed was terrible...The street also is so much unpleasant with buildings that look like abandoned, you need to climb up a hill on narrow street without normal sidewalks and everything together makes it extremely hard carry the luggage. We spent only 3 nights in this apartment and I swear if I had booking for longer time I would move out earlier and pay extra for something more decent. Ps. While we were leaving the apartment a cleaning lady came, and judging by how dirty she was herself, I don't think that this lady has any idea about what good cleaning means at all.

the location is perfect if you want to experience Istanbul for the first time. 20 min walk from the metro from SAW airport, which is very convenient.
the apartment is clean and looks like in tje pictures!
the location however is in a very loud street and the mattress is very thin. if you have scoliosis or other back problems like I have, thia might be the right airbnb for you.
lastly, the host didnt communicate very well prior to my visit. i think she should work on that.

We had a wonderful time staying at this Airbnb. It’s in a great location. We walked the streets and to the coast of Moda several times during the week.
There are tons of restaurants within a 15 minute walk or less. You can walk to the ocean in 15-25 minutes. There’s a beautiful view of the European side
The space is small but everything you need for a stay for 1-2 people. The bathroom was very nice with hot water and a removable shower head.
I worked on my computer at the desk and my husband worked at the kitchen table. It was easy to get into the building and the room is on the 4th floor. The WiFi worked good and we used the stovetop for a few meals.
The host was very responsive and easy to talk to. I would definitely recommend staying here!

description:
This chic and large apartment is the perfect base for exploring Istanbul, being both safe and central.
It is too cozy , large and comfortable.
The flat has 2 bedrooms one of has an ac other units have fans, and one ac in the livingroom.Fully equipped kitchen and an enjoyable living room which has a swing. You feel the soul of the neighbourhood with a very authentic street view.
One of the rare buildings with elevator.

reviews.text: Özra's place wasn'tquite what we expected, but we had a good stay overall. Starting with the positives: the apartment is very well located, just a couple of minutes' walk to the metro and funicular. It is very large - much bigger than it appears on the photos - and the living room is bright and airy. The apartment was clean and the beds were comfy enough. The kitchen was well stocked with utensils and there were two bottles of water for us in the fridge when we arrived, which was a welcome touch. The lift was very handy. Turning to the not so good: the apartment is in need of some maintenance. The taps in both bathrooms were so loose that I was worried they would come off in my hand. There is a decorative cap on the shower rail which fell off every time I had a shower. The vanity unit which the sink sits on is cracked. These issues aren't major but made the apartment feel a little shabby. The noise from the street on Friday and Saturday night was extraordinarily loud. Earplugs needed.

A spacious and cutely decorated apartment with plenty of space. The rooms could easily sleep two to a bed and the main bedroom floor and living room floor could accommodate more if you have several guests (it was just me, but I appreciated the large space). The check in process was flexible, and there’s a small elevator from the ground floor (floor 0) to the third floor (fits one person with luggage, or 1-2 other people). The apartment itself reminded me of the designs from those cute apartments in San Francisco. It was very clean, and there’s apartment was kept heated. There’s a washer to do laundry, and a rack to dry your clothes plus an iron and ironing board to get any wrinkles out. The neighborhood is vibrant and right next to Pera’s Bakery and plenty of other restaurants and bars. It’s also very close to the metro, which I would recommend over a taxi, as taxi prices are quite expensive. The location is perfectly situated between restaurant and shopping. Definitely recommended.

The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly like the photos.
It’s right in the heart of Istanbul’s historic Beyoğlu neighborhood, and the apartment itself is a nice example of an old Istanbul building, which gives it a lot of character.
The area (and the apartment) can be a bit noisy on weekends, but it’s much quieter during the weekdays. Check-in was easy and the host was very responsive and helpful.
Overall, a smooth and enjoyable stay—would definitely recommend!

Every penny you spend to stay here is more than worth it. The house is just wow and photos don’t do justice to this perfect place. This is a big house and very tastefully decorated by the host. Host is so sweet and humble. She is very helpful and also helped us by walking in when we were not able to operate an item. I wish we could stay longer here. Absolutely loved the place. Very walkable to the high street and placed so near to most attractions. I highly recommended this place. Impeccable and perfect apartment. This has made our stay so enjoyable and memorable. Love from India 🇮🇳🙏🙏

Great place to stay! Extremely centrally located with many great restaurants in the area. Easy access to public transport. The apartment was clean and very nicely decorated, with helpful amenities like laundry. Ozra was a very attentive host and messaged back nearly instantly every time. Lots of other reviews complain about noise from the street, and yes, there is some noise which should be expected given you are centrally located in a large city, but as soon as you close the windows, the sounds from the street are basically eliminated.
Also please note that there was a family of kittens outside the back door of the building, and this along was worth a 5 star review.

description:
This one-bedroom apartment represents sophisticated luxury, offering all comforts of a home. From the layout to the décor, each detail articulates a superior standard of living, featuring a living room with open kitchen and dining area, a bedroom and a bathroom.

Apartment is located on Basin Express in the heart of İstanbul. It is between 2 important highways TEM&E5
15 min to Avrasya Tunel
25 min to Taksim,
30 min to Istanbul Airport
5 min to Mall of Istanbul & 212 Mall & Stars City Mall

reviews.text: My stay here was amazing. The host was not only a great communicator and presented the apartment even better than the photos she was also very kind and went above and beyond to ensure I felt right at home in Istanbul. The apartment is perfect for anyone looking for a home away from home for a quick getaway or an extended stay. Even with a language barrier concierge was always very helpful and never failed to greet me with a smile. It is very easy to get a taxi here at any time night or day, it’s about 20-30 minutes from most of Istanbul’s nightlife scene and historical landmarks. There are multiple restaurants, grocery stores, tailors, and hair salons all within walking distance. The apartment itself was very clean and modern, equipped with a great central air conditioning system perfect for hot Istanbul summers. In my over a month stay I never even heard my neighbors it is a very quiet building. If you are looking for a place to stay in Istanbul look no further.

We had a very good time at the place.
Everything was on point. Clean, and tidy, as it is shown in the photos.
Thanks for Ebru

Staying at Ebru's place was amazing! 5 star! It is beautifully interior designed and so comfortable, it's like a top luxury apartment. Ebru is a fantastic host and so helpful and made my stay even better. I will definitely come and stay here again.
Oliver

Ebru and her husband Adi were the best host you can expect. On check in I arrived at 1.30am and Adi was there to welcome me and that was special and appreciated due to flight arriving late.
Ebru also was so so kind to provide apps that delivered food and groceries.
Downstairs there are 2 convenience stores which came very handy.
In all it felt like home and really really recommend them both as fantastic hosts

Very nice place, great host, very clean.
Highly recommended.
Many thanks

description:
Brew coffee and fix breakfast in a cozy kitchen with granite counters and dine at a bar-style breakfast table beneath trendy pendant lights. Sprawl out with a book on a relaxed sofa amid the understated decor and hardwood floors of this radiant flat. Our flat is on the 4th floor, offering a great terrace.

It's a newly renovated 1 bedroom apartment with a beautiful partly sea view terrace. It’s located on a quiet street in the Cihangir area. It's a sunny and peaceful apartment.

The apartment is stylish and all of the furniture and appliances are new. It has 2 large terrace, one in the front one at the back side.İn the front terrace we have a beautiful dining space and an umbrella. You can chill with pleasure and enjoy the views of İstanbul.

It's on the 4th floor without an elevator. We can accommodate up to 5 people : two in the bedroom (a real comfy double bed) , two on the pull-out couch in the living room and one on the sofa in the bedroom .

reviews.text:
It is difficult to walk from the metro station to the house because it is on a high hill! The most difficult thing is that it is located on the fourth floor without an elevator. And you will have to call a taxi each time you go out.
The apartment is not as described on the website and is very small compared to the pictures. Its price is also expensive compared to its geographical location.
Ac wasn’t working (small compressor)placed in the hall. 38C outside so imagine how hot 🥵 it was Bedroom have only classic fan and no Ac.
The place is clean but very old furnitures.

Berna's place is perfectly located as it close to Taksim Square. Surely though, the area needs someone who is physically fit to be able to go up the steep hill to reach the Square. Also, just like what the host said.. you will also need to climb 4 floors by stairs to reach the beautiful apartment. Nonetheless, the apartment was clean and as accurate as shown on the photos. Berna spoke to us over the phone when we reached his place and we were welcomed with a small bag of chocolate and a nice cold bottle of water which was a really good touch. This place is HIGHLY RECOMMENDED as well as the host who is always quick to respond to queries/issues. Once again, thank you for hosting our stay in Istanbul.

We found that unfortunately the photos did not accurately reflect the space. For example, the bedding was not white as pictured and instead orange. The apartment did not look, smell, or feel clean—particularly the bed linens and bath towels. There were issues with bugs (ants) in the apartment throughout our stay. The bathroom door could not fully be closed otherwise it would jam and be unable to open. The door handle to the back terrace off the bedroom was broken & there was no way to lock it, so safety was a concern. The AC cooled down the living room & kitchen areas, but the bedroom had no AC. This would not have been a problem since there was a fan. However, the fan was in extremely poor condition and essentially broken. It needs to be replaced. The location was good if you are hoping to be in Taksim Square. If you have a lot of luggage keep in mind the four flights of stairs and no elevator. The terrace was nice. However, we were very disappointed as we had hoped since it was listed as an “Airbnb Plus” that it would be comfortable and clean. Especially since for the amount we paid for one week you can rent a nicer apartment in the same area in Istanbul for one month.

The positives:
- The property itself is in an old building (but this is just Istanbul! It’s character), it is spacious, well decorated and more than enough room for two to three people, two balconies and most things work perfectly. Shower is slow and take a while to become warm but rain shower usually does that. The balconies are nice and spacious, quiet too which is unexpectedly nice.
- The location is superb, it’s located in the middle of Taksim but it’s absolutely peaceful and quiet. You can hear road noises but in a city, it’s expected.
- Brilliant responsive host!
Negatives:
- It’s a hike & lots of stairs. I would not recommend if you hate hiking/walking — but we love to eat so it helps us justify it 😂
- The apartment needs maintaining— tap loose, door handles loose, shower is not fixed in place I was scared to break it. Apartment is not as modern as the pictures anymore but it’s regular wear and tear. Fridge isn’t that cold. Some instructions written by pencil and are fading.

A very nice appartment - exactly as described and shown on the photos. Clean and comfortable. With enough space and kitchen annex.
Perfect location - very close to Taksim square and Istiklal caddesi (avenue). The check in/out system is very convenient.
Berna is an excellent host, very easy to communicate with. We highly recommend this place to every one visiting Istanbul.

description: Uskudar is the most ancient area in the Anatolian side of the Bosphorus with its Maiden Tower, Palaces, Turkish baths, Turkish bazaar and many other historical places. Our 3+1 (3 BR) apartment is 600 meter distance to the Bosphorus, Ferry and Marmaray train terminals that takes you to the ancient city on the European side in 20 minutes.

reviews.text:
Freshly renovated tidy and very clean AirBnb apartment equipped with everything we needed such as clean towels and sheets. Kitchen utensils were available ,the host provided tea and coffee she didn’t had to but that was a nice gesture.
The apartment was close to few supermarket as which was handy, and few steps to several local restaurants ,cafes and local markets.
when it comes to public transportation buses ,ferry ships and metro are available.
But if you are in a wheelchair or have a stroller communication can be challenging because many metro stations does not have elevators or pathways and sometimes elevators can be located far away from the station.
Finally Fusun is the most thoughtful, gracious host , she was there when we need her.
She provided us with all the information we needed and answered all questions we had she even left a note with Wi-Fi password and a few helpful recommendations.
We had a great stay!

Our host was very welcoming, and the house was well-maintained and clean. However, there was an issue with the toilet's fan, which led to some unpleasant odors in the bathroom. Additionally, one of the rooms was quite small and unusable due to persistent bird noise from the roof, making it uncomfortable for one person to stay there. This was a bit challenging for our group of 6 adults and a 3-year-old baby as one of us didn't have a proper bed.
The location was a bit far from the main tourist attractions in Istanbul, resulting in higher transportation costs. Despite these challenges, we managed to enjoy our stay in this part of Istanbul. If the issues with the bathroom and the noisy room can be resolved, this place could offer a more comfortable stay for future guests.

Amazing stay.
Great, comfy, quiet and clean apartment in amazing neighborhood. A lot of restaurants nearby (great burek place just 1minute away). Very close to buses and boats.
Everything was like on the photos.
The host extremely helpful and communicative.
100% recommended

Once I made my reservation Füsun reached out to me and was very welcoming. My family and I looked forward to our trip to Istanbul.
Once we landed Füsun welcomed us to Turkiye and said she would meet us at the property. We met as planned in front of the property and she explained how to enter the property.
When we stepped into the apartment it was exactly as in the pictures, clean, we organized and even some surprises. Füsun provided snacks, fruit , local pastries and soft drinks. This was not expected.
Everything in the apartment was clean and worked properly.
We had a wonderful time in Istanbul and we look forward to our next trip where we will book one of three apartments that Füsun has.
Thank you Füsun !!!

Fosun and her husband were very patient with our arrival time and left a wonderful cake and fruits for us along with instructions. We had small connection problem with WiFi and they were very helpful even offering to come over. A lovely flat which is walkable to metro and ferries to explore Istanbul.

description:
***Only families or Solo Travelers***
1 bedroom +1 living . the flat is on the 2nd floor with an elevator.
located in Kuştepe /Şişli right behind Trump Tower , close to everywhere .
" Simplicity is the ultimate sophistication ".

reviews.text:
We enjoyed our stay overall, but there were some downsides. One sofa had a broken arm propped up with a small table, and another near the TV was cracked and unsafe to use. The kitchenware was not in good shape, as many dishes were chipped or cracked. One bowl accidentally broke during our stay, but the host kindly did not charge us, which we appreciated. The furniture and linens matched the photos, though now most items feel worn, especially the mattresses and sheets.
On the positive side, the location was convenient with a supermarket, bakery, butcher, and pharmacy nearby. The neighborhood felt safe with a police station close. However, walking from the main street takes about 15 minutes with some uphill and downhill paths, which could be tiring.
The biggest drawback was the mosque directly across the street, where the loud and frequent call to prayer disturbed our rest. Still, the host was polite, responsive, and kind, which made our stay pleasant.

It was a very nice experience to stay in this apartment. Everything in the apartment was very clean and new. All staff that you need for cocking was provided. Also Wahingliquid, shampoo, dushgel, tea, coffee. Good quality towels and bedsheets have been provided. You could feel that Moussaab cares about the well-being of his guests. On our questions he responded always very quickly. The check-in instructions were very clear. The location of apartment is very good. Very close to the Trump Tower and metro. The stay in this apartment was worth of the price that we payed.

Moussaab’s house is beautiful, and renovated beautifully. Kitchen, well equipped, brand-new appliances. Moussaab was excellent host, very accommodating, always available to answer calls within short period of time. He offered lots of insight and help around the area. Great restaurants and the fast-food restaurants within reach. Big -Cevahir- mall walking distance lest then 5 minutes. Transportation both public and taxi across the road. I forgot to say place is very clean with modern bathroom with comfortable bed, in safe neighbourhood. I highly recommend!

Everything is as described. I had problem with hot water once and I messaged the host at 11pm, he immediately replied and did a video call with me to show me how to resolve the issue. Fantastic! The location is next to a mosque so loud prayers start at 5am but last only for 2 minutes or so. Trump Mall is about a 10 minutes walk.

Moussaab and his place were truly wonderful. his place matched exactly what was described, everything was clean/up to date, and was easy to check in. Now moussaab is the real reason if we need to go back to istanbul, this will be the place that we will be staying at. He was friendly, helpful. From booking he responded so quickly and can't recommend this location enough. 5 stars ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

description:
Enjoy a simple and comfortable stay in this centrally located quiet place with city views.

Within walking distance to Nişantaşı, Beşiktaş Ferry Port, Kabataş Tram Station, Maçka Park, Beşiktaş Bazaar, Akaretler Sıra houses. Close to Taksim Square-Istiklal Street, Harbiye, Osmanbey Metro station.

There are many cafes and restaurants nearby, it is one of the special districts of Istanbul.

•City View
• Balcony
• Blackout curtains
• Suitable for families with children

reviews.text:
If I could give 10 out of 5 stars, I would! Yunus is an exceptional host. We had an extremely difficult situation — our flight was delayed by more than 24 hours and I was traveling with a 2-year-old. Yanus was incredibly understanding and helped us navigate everything with patience and kindness. That, to me, is what matters most in a host.
The apartment itself is wonderful — cozy, spotlessly clean, and exactly as described. The balcony view over the city is breathtaking, and we truly enjoyed our breakfasts and dinners at home. The location is fantastic: a grocery store 3 minutes away, a lovely street with restaurants and a larger supermarket nearby, and Dolmabahçe Palace just a 15-minute walk. Despite our hectic trip, we even managed to do some sightseeing.
Everything you need was already there — coffee capsules, salt, sugar, cleaning supplies, soap, shower gel, toilet paper. So convenient for short stays, no shopping needed!
Huge thanks to Yunus — highly recommended to future guests!

Younes is a great host. The location was convenient, and overall, my stay was positive. However, to provide a fair and balanced review for future guests, I should mention a few things:
There is street parking available, but no dedicated parking for the apartment.
The doors are quite squeaky.
The walls are very thin, making it easy to hear the neighbors above.
We had a child with us, and the crib did not have a mattress. If you have specific preferences regarding this, it’s best to inform Younes in advance, and he’ll assist you.
The location is excellent, close to everything. There is much to explore beyond Taksim. Taksim Square is about a 5-minute drive or a 15-minute walk (though walking in Istanbul can be challenging).
Younes is very responsive at all times.

Great place to stay clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was friendly and responsive, and the check-in process was easy. I had a great experience and would definitely stay here again.
Even above my expectations. Very clean, very comfortable at an excellent location. Host is very helpful and easy to communicate. Eager to stay again.
Great stay! The house was spotless, exactly like the photos, and in a perfect central location. Check-in and check-out were smooth, and communication with the host was super easy. Highly recommend!

description: The building is brand new and located at one of the most central locations in the city. You can take the ferry directly to the historical city centre Sultanahmet or hang out in the neighbourhood, Kadıköy, which is one of the most colorful and popular areas in Istanbul. Since this is a brand new building it is fully earthquake proof, complying with all the up to date requirements.

reviews.text: I stayed here for a week and everything was great. The apartment is clean, new, and exactly as shown in the photos. It could be a bit cozier, with more lighting since there isn’t much natural light. There’s not much kitchenware, but there is a dishwasher. It was very pleasant to communicate with the owners and the building staff — everyone was kind and helpful. The location is excellent, close to the bus and ferry stations. I recommend this place to those who value comfort, peace, and spend most of their time outside.

The apartment is in a new building - a rarity for the Kadıköy. There is an elevator in the building. The apartment looks much better in real life than on the photo. The apartment was clean and warm. There is a possibility to regulate the temperature. The apartment is located in a very calm and quiet street, despite the fact that the area is quite noisy. Everything you need is in walking distance - supermarkets, coffee shops, bars, metro station, pier and bus stops. From here you can conveniently get to all the main directions of Istanbul. In 5 minutes from the apartment there is a stop of transfer buses to the airports. The apartment has the necessary things for a short stay - iron, hair dryer, etc. If you plan a longer stay, you may need to buy some things (toilet paper, washing powder, etc.). The apartment is suitable for those looking for a workspace. Internet was fast and stable. A nice bonus was the Smart TV. This seems like the perfect apartment to choose on your next visit.

Everything was exactly as described and shown in the pictures. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and well-equipped for both short and longer stays. It’s located centrally on the Asian side of Istanbul in Kadikoy, with the ferry port to the European side just a 5-minute walk away. The metro station is about 10 minutes on foot, and the lively area with cafés and restaurants can be reached within 15 minutes. The location is perfect for exploring both sides of the city.
Suat and Cem were incredibly friendly and helpful throughout our stay. Suat, in particular, was always available and made sure we had everything we needed, whether it was something for the apartment or local tips on where to go, including places to watch football or eat. Their warm hospitality made us feel genuinely welcome. We’d definitely recommend staying here!

We had a comfortable stay, very helpful and very responsive host. The check in was smooth and warm welcoming and made us feel relaxed.
Over all it’s a clean and compact apartment. The place does look more spacious in the pictures. Host very responsive and available in case of any issues. Special thanks to very kind Suat who was always out of way helpful.
The only problem during the stay was abnoxious drunk guys yelling and talking very loud all night until 4 am on the street.
There was problem with internet that was only available in one part of the apartment (living room) There was no internet if you moved away from the living room, but not a big issue. The bathroom exhaust is loud and can be fixed.

My husband and I stayed at the apartment for 10 days. The communication prior our arrival and throughout the whole stay was friendly and proactive with both, Cem and Suat. We’ve seen Suat every other day, a very warm and kind man, he was always hospitable and overall his regular presence on the property and responsiveness assured us that the place is very well looked for.
Our requests were addressed (once we needed a clothing dryer and was promptly provided with it). Check-in was quick and smooth – Suat gave us a tour, and the place looked exactly as pictured. Very clean and you feel at ease with the relaxing interior. Despite us knowing it was supposed to be a lively neighborhood, it was quiet inside. Everything works and in great condition — we cooked and washed our clothes without any problems. Water pressure was great too, which was important to me. About ten minutes walking distance to ferries. Many small supermarkets around the corner, and a large MM Migros ~20 min.
Thank you!

description: This prestigious apartment in a recently renovated historic building is located in the famous Galata district, on a peaceful street just 200 meters from the Şişhane metro station. With high ceilings, stylish furniture and spacious rooms designed by a famous architect, the apartment is equipped with all the necessary appliances. Our professional team will be happy to provide you with 24/7 online concierge service to make your stay comfortable.

reviews.text:
We had a decent stay at this Airbnb. Though it could come better with the amount of price that we paid.
The host was incredibly responsive, polite, and friendly, making our check-in smooth and providing helpful tips about the area. The location is fantastic, with plenty of local restaurants within walking distance and easy access to public transportation.
However, the surrounding area felt a bit desolate, with abandoned buildings nearby, making nighttime walks somewhat intimidating, although we didn't encounter any issues.
A couple of downsides to note: Firstly, there weren't enough towels provided for our party of two, which was a bit inconvenient. Secondly, the toilet flushing mechanism didn't work well, continuously making noise after each flush. Thirdly, the shower drain was clogged, causing water to drain very slowly. Lastly, the cleaning was not done properly. We found hair on the pillow and quite a lot of water stain on the shower door.

While the apartment is in a very central location and the host was very responsive, a few issues with the apartment have left us quite disappointed with the rental.
While the decoration is cute, the pictures on the ad suggest a luminous apartment with a view above surrounding buildings and the sky, we were instead located on the first floor, in a room quite dark and a view on the abandoned adjacent buildings.
But the most disappointing points were about the condition and cleanliness of the place.. smell of cigarettes when entering the room, dirty rug and bathmats, stains and hairs on the couch and bathroom walls, broken toilet seat and bedroom lamp.. This is unfortunately well below standards for this price.
I'd suggest the hosts to do something about these points also mentioned by other customers, as the apartments has besides that everything to make for a pleasant stay.

Great place to stay in Istanbul! We stayed for 5 nights and it was a perfect location for us, easy to walk to attractions or take the tram anywhere around the city. It’s a lovely area away from the most touristy places in Istanbul but still easily accessible. Super friendly host, clean apartment and exactly like the photos. Would recommend anyone to stay here!!

Happy to stay at this appartement. Burak is a very good host and very helpful, very good in communication. Any time we needed his help he was always will to satisfy us. The apartement is brand new and decorated with good aesthetics. Very comfort matress, and hot water in the bathroom. The room needed to be better cleaned and unfortunately we had just one towel to use during our stay there. Very hot during all the day, and we couldn't control the heat so we needed to sleep with an open window. If you hate the high temperature, you need to highlight this to the owner.
Extra tip: Very good location ideal for anyone who wants to reach the center or the public transport. The apartement is near to Galata Tower but also 10 min. by foot to the Galata Port; great place to visit and stroll around. You may find mini market, artistic cafes and delicious tranditional street food.
+ I would stay there again, for sure.

If you are looking for a perfect location in Istanbul at a cheap price, this is it.
However aside from location, our experience was not that good.
- Loud noise late at night from a nearby bar
- Shower floods during every use
- Wifi does not work
- Apartment is not clean
- Bedsheets + sofa had hairs and stains on
- Stairwell stinks of cigarettes

description: In these houses, the guest is given a new pillow and quilt purchased from the store. The facility is located adjacent to the Hotels. Naz City, Sheraton, Hilton Bosphorus away 2 minutes . Çırağan Palace Kempinski, Four Seasons, Grand Bazaar, Sultanahmet, Hagia Sophia, Cevahir Mall close 6-12 minutes. The building has a pool, sauna and gym and All rooms air conditioning.

reviews.text: The stay was wonderful. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was great and Deniz was a very kind and helpful host. I would definitely stay here again. Highly recommended!

5-Star Review: Amazing Stay in the Heart of Şişli!
I’m from America and stayed at this wonderful Airbnb in Şişli, Turkey, for 13 days, and it exceeded all my expectations. The location was absolutely perfect—right in the heart of the city, with easy access to shops, restaurants, and public transportation, making it incredibly convenient to explore Istanbul.
The apartment itself was spotless, spacious, and very well-equipped with all the amenities I needed for a comfortable stay. The bed was incredibly comfortable, the kitchen had everything needed to prepare meals, and the Wi-Fi was reliable—perfect for both relaxation and work. I also loved the balcony, which offered a lovely view of the surrounding area, making it a great place to unwind after a long day.
The host was extremely responsive, helpful, and went above and beyond to ensure my stay was perfect. I highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul and would absolutely stay here again.

We had a great stay at this Airbnb in Istanbul. The location was really convenient, especially for getting around Taksim and exploring the city. The apartment was comfortable, clean and had everything we needed during our stay.
Communication was easy and everything went smoothly from check-in to check-out. There are plenty of restaurants, shops and transport options nearby, which made the location really practical.
Overall, we really enjoyed our stay and would happily recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul. Thanks again for having us!

We travelled as a family with three kids. The place was very clean and had everything we needed. The kids also enjoyed dipping into the pool after long days out. Proximity to Taksim square by walking was also great, despite a small stretch of uphill which was a challenge for our small one. Access to public transport and shops for groceries was also great. Host was also very nice and responsive. Overall, it was a great place and we’ve enjoyed our stay.

An amazing stay in the heart of Istanbul with free parking and pool & gym .. everything is available nearby and super responsive and friendly host .. Deniz left a gift 🎁 for us last day 😍 … thanks Deniz for the amazing experience

description: Have a breath in the center of the city. The place is in karakoy which is close to taksim, galata, eminonu, besiktas and galataport.

reviews.text: Great location, easy check in. Comfortable for a few nights' stay
Everything was good, safe area, close to all the main touristic area, host was responsive and always helpful. However room was not very clean.
Stayed here on a short stay in Istanbul, great location, lovely small studio apartment, easy check in/out and the host was very responsive!
Everything was so good, you can take a walk at night in the neighbourhood. The room was designed so nice and comfortable, i will definitely stay again.

Excelente location , amazing neighbourhood, Yunus is a delightful host , he has such a good taste to decorate his airbnb .
I decided to stay Longer as I m loving his place. .
Best experience ever .
Karakoy is a great place to stay in Istanbul

description:
Super bright and sunny place in Galata district. Brand new furnished apartment comes with 2 AC & 2 Bathroom & dedicated work space.

Two bedroom apartment in a very nice and quiet area close to famous Galata Tower, Istiklal Avenue, Karakoy, markets and public transport.

Located on the 3rd floor in a building which was recently completely renovated.

I'm happy to welcome you as a friend and will happy to show you our hospitality!

reviews.text:
In Istanbul, location is everything, and this apartment has a great location.
It’s important to note that there is no actual parking, the parking is around the corner at a public parking, and is paid additionally.
There is no elevator as was stated in the description.
The apartment was more than fine, though there could have been more attention paid to maintenance, with four out of five dining room chairs falling apart. They should also be cleaned since they’re covered in stains.
The normal bathroom was fine, except that the shower head had almost no pressure. The en a suite has not really been properly cleaned, but there is a mop handy, so wasn’t an issue to clean it.
